# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/azure.nl.mdx

title: Azure Entra
icon: Azure
description: >-
  Leer hoe je LibreChat configureert om Azure Entra te gebruiken voor
  gebruikersauthenticatie.

1. Ga naar de [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/) en meld je aan met je account.
2. Typ "Azure Entra" in het zoekvak en klik erop.
3. Klik in het linkermenu op App registrations en vervolgens op New registration.
4. Geef je app een naam en selecteer Web als het platformtype.
5. Voer in het veld Redirect URI je LibreChat OpenID callback-URL in en klik op Register. Gebruik voor lokale Docker-installaties `http://localhost:3080/oauth/openid/callback`. Vervang voor geïmplementeerde instanties `http://localhost:3080` door je publieke `DOMAIN_SERVER`-waarde, bijvoorbeeld `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/2b1aabce-850e-4165-bf76-3c1984f10b6c)

6. Je ziet een Overzichtspagina met wat informatie over je app. Kopieer de Application (client) ID en de Directory (tenant) ID en sla deze ergens op.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/e67d5e97-e26d-48a5-aa6e-50de4450b1fd)

7. Klik in het linkermenu op Authentication en vink de vakjes voor Access tokens en ID tokens aan onder Implicit grant and hybrid flows.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/88a16cbc-ff68-4b3a-ba7b-b380cc3d2366)

8. Klik in het linkermenu op Certificates & Secrets en vervolgens op New client secret. Geef je secret een naam en een vervaldatum en klik op Add. Je ziet een Value-kolom met je secret. Kopieer deze en sla deze ergens op. Deel deze met niemand!

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/31aa6cee-5402-4ce0-a950-1b7e147aafc8)

9. Als je de toegang per groep wilt beperken, moet je de groups claim toevoegen aan het token. Ga hiervoor naar Token configuration en klik op Add group claim. Selecteer de groepen die je in het token wilt opnemen en klik op Add.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/c9d353f5-2cb2-4f00-b4f0-493cfec8fe9a)

10. Open het .env bestand in je projectmap en voeg de volgende variabelen toe met de waarden die je hebt gekopieerd:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page
ALLOW_SOCIAL_LOGIN=true

OPENID_CLIENT_ID=Your Application (client) ID
OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET=Your client secret
OPENID_ISSUER=https://login.microsoftonline.com/Your Directory (tenant ID)/v2.0/
OPENID_SESSION_SECRET=Any random string
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email #DO NOT CHANGE THIS
OPENID_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/openid/callback # this should be the same for everyone

OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_TOKEN_KIND=id

# If you want to restrict access by groups
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_PARAMETER_PATH="roles"
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE="Your Group Name" # Single role or comma-separated roles (e.g., Group1,Group2,Admin)

# Optional: redirects the user to the end session endpoint after logging out
OPENID_USE_END_SESSION_ENDPOINT=true

# Maximum logout URL length before using logout_hint instead of id_token_hint (default: 2000)
# OPENID_MAX_LOGOUT_URL_LENGTH=2000
```

De redirect URI die in Azure is geregistreerd, moet exact overeenkomen met de URL die LibreChat gebruikt. Als `DOMAIN_SERVER=https://chat.example.com`, dan moet Azure `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback` gebruiken.

11. Sla het .env bestand op

> Let op: Als je Docker gebruikt, voer dan `docker compose up -d` uit om de wijzigingen in de .env configuratie toe te passen.

## Geavanceerd: Tokenhergebruik [#advanced-token-reuse]

LibreChat ondersteunt het hergebruik van Azure Entra ID-tokens voor sessiebeheer, wat kan zorgen voor een betere integratie met uw Azure-omgeving. Deze functie stelt LibreChat in staat om Azure's refresh tokens te gebruiken in plaats van zijn eigen sessietokens te beheren.

Voor meer informatie over deze functie en hoe je deze configureert, zie [Re-use OpenID Tokens for Login Session](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/token-reuse).

## Geavanceerd: Microsoft Graph API-integratie [#advanced-microsoft-graph-api-integration]

Wanneer je Azure Entra ID gebruikt als je OpenID-provider, kun je Microsoft Graph API-integratie inschakelen om het systeem voor rechten en delen te verbeteren met zoekmogelijkheden voor personen en groepen.

### Vereisten [#prerequisites]

1. Uw Azure-appregistratie moet beschikken over de juiste Microsoft Graph API-machtigingen
2. Beheerdersinstemming kan vereist zijn voor bepaalde Graph API-scopes (zoals `GroupMember.Read.All`)

### Graph API-machtigingen toevoegen [#adding-graph-api-permissions]

1. Ga in je Azure-appregistratie naar **API permissions**
2. Klik op **Add a permission** > **Microsoft Graph** > **Delegated permissions**
3. Voeg deze permissies toe:
   - `User.Read` - Aanmelden en gebruikersprofiel lezen
   - `People.Read` - Gebruikerscontacten lezen
   - `GroupMember.Read.All` - Lees alle groepslidmaatschappen
   - `User.ReadBasic.All` - Lees alle basisprofielen van gebruikers
4. Klik op **Grant admin consent** indien vereist (je hebt hiervoor beheerdersrechten nodig)

### Configuratie [#configuration]

<Callout type="error" title="Vereist: Tokenhergebruik inschakelen">
**Belangrijk:** Je MOET OpenID tokenhergebruik inschakelen om deze functie te laten werken:
```bash filename=".env"
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
```
Zie [Token Reuse Configuration](#advanced-token-reuse) hierboven voor details.
</Callout>

Voeg de volgende omgevingsvariabelen toe aan je `.env` bestand:

```bash filename=".env"
# Enable Entra ID people search in permissions/sharing
USE_ENTRA_ID_FOR_PEOPLE_SEARCH=true

# Include group owners as members when searching groups
ENTRA_ID_INCLUDE_OWNERS_AS_MEMBERS=true

# Microsoft Graph API scopes (these are automatically included with the OpenID scopes)
OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES=User.Read,People.Read,GroupMember.Read.All,User.ReadBasic.All
```

Wanneer ingeschakeld, zal de personenkiezer in de dialoogvensters voor machtigingen en delen:
- Doorzoek zowel lokale LibreChat-gebruikers als Azure Entra ID-gebruikers
- Toon gebruikersprofielen met namen en e-mailadressen van uw organisatie
- Toestaan van het zoeken naar en selecteren van Azure Entra ID-groepen
- Toon groepsleden op basis van uw Graph API-rechten

### Opmerkingen [#notes]

- **Token reuse (`OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true`) is verplicht** om deze functie te laten werken
- De `OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES` worden automatisch toegevoegd aan je bestaande `OPENID_SCOPE` tijdens authenticatie.
- Groepszoekopdrachten vereisen de `GroupMember.Read.All` permissie, waarvoor doorgaans toestemming van een beheerder vereist is.
- Gebruikerszoekopdrachten werken met de basisrechten `User.Read`, `People.Read` en `User.ReadBasic.All`

## Geavanceerd: SharePoint-integratie [#advanced-sharepoint-integration]

LibreChat kan worden geïntegreerd met SharePoint Online en OneDrive for Business, waardoor gebruikers direct bestanden kunnen bladeren en bijvoegen vanuit hun SharePoint-bibliotheken.

### Vereisten [#prerequisites-1]

1. Aan alle vereisten van [Token Reuse](#advanced-token-reuse) moet worden voldaan
2. Je Azure-appregistratie heeft aanvullende SharePoint-machtigingen nodig
3. Uw Azure-appregistratie moet een LibreChat API-scope beschikbaar stellen en verlenen, zoals `api://<client-id>/access_as_user`

### SharePoint-machtigingen toevoegen [#adding-sharepoint-permissions]

1. Ga in je Azure-appregistratie naar **API permissions**
2. Klik op **Add a permission**

#### Voor SharePoint-toegang: [#for-sharepoint-access]
3. Selecteer **SharePoint** (niet Microsoft Graph)
4. Kies **Delegated permissions**
5. Toevoegen: `AllSites.Read` - Items in alle siteverzamelingen lezen

#### Voor bestanddownloads: [#for-file-downloads]
6. Klik nogmaals op **Add a permission**
7. Selecteer **Microsoft Graph**
8. Kies **Delegated permissions**
9. Toevoegen: `Files.Read.All` - Lees alle bestanden waartoe de gebruiker toegang heeft

10. Klik op **Grant admin consent** voor beide machtigingen

### Configuratie [#configuration-1]

Voordat je de SharePoint-variabelen inschakelt, moet je ervoor zorgen dat de configuratie voor het hergebruik van het OpenID-token de LibreChat app API-scope aanvraagt. Dit geeft Azure een app-audience toegangstoken dat kan worden gebruikt als de on-behalf-of assertion voor SharePoint- en Graph-tokenuitwisseling.

```bash filename=".env"
# OpenID token reuse and OBO-compatible audience
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email offline_access api://<client-id>/access_as_user
OPENID_ON_BEHALF_FLOW_FOR_USERINFO_REQUIRED=true

# Enable SharePoint file picker
ENABLE_SHAREPOINT_FILEPICKER=true

# Your SharePoint tenant URL
SHAREPOINT_BASE_URL=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com

# SharePoint scope for file picker (replace 'yourtenant' with your actual tenant)
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_SHAREPOINT_SCOPE=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com/AllSites.Read

# Graph API scope for downloading files
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_GRAPH_SCOPE=Files.Read.All
```

### Gebruik [#usage]

Indien correct geconfigureerd:
1. Gebruikers zullen de optie "From SharePoint" zien in het menu voor bestandsbijlagen
2. Als je hierop klikt, wordt de systeemeigen SharePoint-bestandsverkenner geopend
3. Gebruikers kunnen bestanden doorzoeken en selecteren vanaf elke SharePoint-site of OneDrive waartoe zij toegang hebben
4. Geselecteerde bestanden worden gedownload en toegevoegd aan het gesprek

<Callout type="warning" title="Beveiligingsopmerking">
De SharePoint-integratie respecteert alle bestaande SharePoint-machtigingen. Gebruikers hebben alleen toegang tot bestanden die ze al mogen bekijken in SharePoint/OneDrive.
</Callout>

Voor gedetailleerde probleemoplossing en geavanceerde configuratie, zie: [SharePoint Integration Guide](/docs/configuration/sharepoint)

title: Azure Entra
icon: Azure
description: >-

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/31aa6cee-5402-4ce0-a950-1b7e147aafc8)

Identyfikator URI przekierowania zarejestrowany w Azure musi dokładnie odpowiadać adresowi URL, pod którym działa LibreChat. Jeśli `DOMAIN_SERVER=https://chat.example.com`, w Azure należy użyć `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`.

11. Zapisz plik .env

> Uwaga: Jeśli używasz Docker, uruchom `docker compose up -d`, aby zastosować zmiany w konfiguracji .env

## Zaawansowane: Ponowne wykorzystanie tokenów [#advanced-token-reuse]

LibreChat obsługuje ponowne wykorzystanie tokenów Azure Entra ID do zarządzania sesjami, co może zapewnić lepszą integrację z Twoim środowiskiem Azure. Ta funkcja pozwala LibreChat na korzystanie z tokenów odświeżania Azure zamiast zarządzania własnymi tokenami sesji.

Aby dowiedzieć się więcej o tej funkcji i sposobie jej konfiguracji, zobacz [Re-use OpenID Tokens for Login Session](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/token-reuse).

## Zaawansowane: Integracja z Microsoft Graph API [#advanced-microsoft-graph-api-integration]

Podczas korzystania z Azure Entra ID jako dostawcy OpenID, możesz włączyć integrację z Microsoft Graph API, aby rozszerzyć system uprawnień i udostępniania o funkcje wyszukiwania osób oraz grup.

### Wymagania wstępne [#prerequisites]

1. Twoja rejestracja aplikacji Azure musi posiadać odpowiednie uprawnienia Microsoft Graph API
2. Zgoda administratora może być wymagana dla niektórych zakresów Graph API (takich jak `GroupMember.Read.All`)

### Dodawanie uprawnień Graph API [#adding-graph-api-permissions]

1. W swojej rejestracji aplikacji Azure przejdź do **API permissions**
2. Kliknij **Add a permission** > **Microsoft Graph** > **Delegated permissions**
3. Dodaj te uprawnienia:
   - `User.Read` - Zaloguj się i odczytaj profil użytkownika
   - `People.Read` - Odczyt kontaktów użytkownika
   - `GroupMember.Read.All` - Odczyt wszystkich członkostw w grupach
   - `User.ReadBasic.All` - Odczyt podstawowych profili wszystkich użytkowników
4. Kliknij **Grant admin consent**, jeśli jest to wymagane (będziesz potrzebować uprawnień administratora)

### Konfiguracja [#configuration]

<Callout type="error" title="Wymagane: Włącz ponowne użycie tokenów">
**Ważne:** Musisz włączyć ponowne użycie tokena OpenID, aby ta funkcja działała:
```bash filename=".env"
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
```
Zobacz [Konfiguracja ponownego użycia tokenów](#advanced-token-reuse) powyżej, aby uzyskać szczegółowe informacje.
</Callout>

Dodaj następujące zmienne środowiskowe do swojego pliku `.env`:

```bash filename=".env"
# Enable Entra ID people search in permissions/sharing
USE_ENTRA_ID_FOR_PEOPLE_SEARCH=true

# Include group owners as members when searching groups
ENTRA_ID_INCLUDE_OWNERS_AS_MEMBERS=true

# Microsoft Graph API scopes (these are automatically included with the OpenID scopes)
OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES=User.Read,People.Read,GroupMember.Read.All,User.ReadBasic.All
```

Po włączeniu, wybieranie osób w oknach dialogowych uprawnień i udostępniania będzie:
- Przeszukuj zarówno lokalnych użytkowników LibreChat, jak i użytkowników Azure Entra ID
- Wyświetlaj profile użytkowników z imionami i adresami e-mail z Twojej organizacji
- Zezwalaj na wyszukiwanie i wybieranie grup Azure Entra ID
- Pokaż członków grupy w oparciu o Twoje uprawnienia Graph API

### Uwagi [#notes]

- **Token reuse (`OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true`) jest wymagane**, aby ta funkcja działała
- `OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES` są automatycznie dołączane do istniejącego `OPENID_SCOPE` podczas uwierzytelniania
- Wyszukiwanie grup wymaga uprawnienia `GroupMember.Read.All`, które zazwyczaj wymaga zgody administratora
- Wyszukiwanie użytkowników działa z podstawowymi uprawnieniami `User.Read`, `People.Read` oraz `User.ReadBasic.All`

## Zaawansowane: Integracja z SharePoint [#advanced-sharepoint-integration]

LibreChat może integrować się z SharePoint Online oraz OneDrive for Business, umożliwiając użytkownikom przeglądanie i załączanie plików bezpośrednio z ich bibliotek SharePoint.

### Wymagania wstępne [#prerequisites-1]

1. Wszystkie wymagania z [Token Reuse](#advanced-token-reuse) muszą zostać spełnione
2. Twoja rejestracja aplikacji Azure wymaga dodatkowych uprawnień SharePoint
3. Twoja rejestracja aplikacji Azure musi udostępniać i przyznawać zakres API LibreChat, taki jak `api://<client-id>/access_as_user`

### Dodawanie uprawnień SharePoint [#adding-sharepoint-permissions]

1. W swojej rejestracji aplikacji Azure przejdź do **API permissions**
2. Kliknij **Add a permission**

#### W celu uzyskania dostępu do SharePoint: [#for-sharepoint-access]
3. Wybierz **SharePoint** (nie Microsoft Graph)
4. Wybierz **Delegated permissions**
5. Dodaj: `AllSites.Read` - Odczytuj elementy we wszystkich kolekcjach witryn

#### Dla pobierania plików: [#for-file-downloads]
6. Kliknij ponownie **Add a permission**
7. Wybierz **Microsoft Graph**
8. Wybierz **Delegated permissions**
9. Dodaj: `Files.Read.All` - Odczyt wszystkich plików, do których użytkownik ma dostęp

10. Kliknij **Grant admin consent** dla obu uprawnień

### Konfiguracja [#configuration-1]

Przed włączeniem zmiennych SharePoint upewnij się, że konfiguracja ponownego użycia tokena OpenID żąda zakresu API aplikacji LibreChat. Daje to Azure token dostępu dla odbiorców aplikacji, który może być użyty jako asercja on-behalf-of do wymiany tokenów SharePoint i Graph.

```bash filename=".env"
# OpenID token reuse and OBO-compatible audience
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email offline_access api://<client-id>/access_as_user
OPENID_ON_BEHALF_FLOW_FOR_USERINFO_REQUIRED=true

# Enable SharePoint file picker
ENABLE_SHAREPOINT_FILEPICKER=true

# Your SharePoint tenant URL
SHAREPOINT_BASE_URL=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com

# SharePoint scope for file picker (replace 'yourtenant' with your actual tenant)
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_SHAREPOINT_SCOPE=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com/AllSites.Read

# Graph API scope for downloading files
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_GRAPH_SCOPE=Files.Read.All
```

### Użycie [#usage]

Po poprawnej konfiguracji:
1. Użytkownicy zobaczą opcję „From SharePoint” w menu załączników plików
2. Kliknięcie go otwiera natywny selektor plików SharePoint
3. Użytkownicy mogą przeglądać i wybierać pliki z dowolnej witryny SharePoint lub usługi OneDrive, do których mają dostęp
4. Wybrane pliki są pobierane i dołączane do konwersacji

<Callout type="warning" title="Uwaga dotycząca bezpieczeństwa">
Integracja z SharePoint respektuje wszystkie istniejące uprawnienia SharePoint. Użytkownicy mogą uzyskiwać dostęp tylko do plików, do których mają już uprawnienia w SharePoint/OneDrive.
</Callout>

Aby uzyskać szczegółowe informacje na temat rozwiązywania problemów i zaawansowanej konfiguracji, zobacz: [SharePoint Integration Guide](/docs/configuration/sharepoint)

# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/azure.pt-BR.mdx

title: Azure Entra
icon: Azure
description: >-
  Aprenda a configurar o LibreChat para usar o Azure Entra para autenticação de
  usuário.

1. Vá para o [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/) e faça login com sua conta.
2. Na caixa de pesquisa, digite "Azure Entra" e clique nela.
3. No menu à esquerda, clique em App registrations e, em seguida, em New registration.
4. Dê um nome ao seu aplicativo e selecione Web como o tipo de plataforma.
5. No campo Redirect URI, insira a URL de callback OpenID do seu LibreChat e clique em Register. Para instalações locais via Docker, use `http://localhost:3080/oauth/openid/callback`. Para instâncias implantadas, substitua `http://localhost:3080` pelo valor do seu `DOMAIN_SERVER` público, por exemplo `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/2b1aabce-850e-4165-bf76-3c1984f10b6c)

6. Você verá uma página de Visão geral (Overview) com algumas informações sobre seu aplicativo. Copie o ID do Aplicativo (cliente) e o ID do Diretório (locatário) e salve-os em algum lugar.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/e67d5e97-e26d-48a5-aa6e-50de4450b1fd)

7. No menu à esquerda, clique em Authentication e marque as caixas para Access tokens e ID tokens em Implicit grant and hybrid flows.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/88a16cbc-ff68-4b3a-ba7b-b380cc3d2366)

8. No menu à esquerda, clique em Certificates & Secrets e depois em New client secret. Dê um nome ao seu secret e uma data de expiração e clique em Add. Você verá uma coluna Value com o seu secret. Copie-o e salve-o em algum lugar. Não o compartilhe com ninguém!

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/31aa6cee-5402-4ce0-a950-1b7e147aafc8)

9. Se você deseja restringir o acesso por grupos, você deve adicionar a claim de grupos ao token. Para fazer isso, vá em Token configuration e clique em Add group claim. Selecione os grupos que deseja incluir no token e clique em Add.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/c9d353f5-2cb2-4f00-b4f0-493cfec8fe9a)

10. Abra o arquivo .env na pasta do seu projeto e adicione as seguintes variáveis com os valores que você copiou:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page
ALLOW_SOCIAL_LOGIN=true

OPENID_CLIENT_ID=Your Application (client) ID
OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET=Your client secret
OPENID_ISSUER=https://login.microsoftonline.com/Your Directory (tenant ID)/v2.0/
OPENID_SESSION_SECRET=Any random string
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email #DO NOT CHANGE THIS
OPENID_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/openid/callback # this should be the same for everyone

OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_TOKEN_KIND=id

# If you want to restrict access by groups
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_PARAMETER_PATH="roles"
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE="Your Group Name" # Single role or comma-separated roles (e.g., Group1,Group2,Admin)

# Optional: redirects the user to the end session endpoint after logging out
OPENID_USE_END_SESSION_ENDPOINT=true

# Maximum logout URL length before using logout_hint instead of id_token_hint (default: 2000)
# OPENID_MAX_LOGOUT_URL_LENGTH=2000
```

O URI de redirecionamento registrado no Azure deve corresponder exatamente à URL que o LibreChat utiliza. Se `DOMAIN_SERVER=https://chat.example.com`, o Azure deve usar `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`.

11. Salve o arquivo .env

> Nota: Se estiver usando Docker, execute `docker compose up -d` para aplicar as alterações de configuração do .env

## Avançado: Reutilização de Tokens [#advanced-token-reuse]

O LibreChat oferece suporte à reutilização de tokens do Azure Entra ID para o gerenciamento de sessões, o que pode proporcionar uma melhor integração com o seu ambiente Azure. Esse recurso permite que o LibreChat utilize os tokens de atualização (refresh tokens) do Azure em vez de gerenciar seus próprios tokens de sessão.

Para saber mais sobre este recurso e como configurá-lo, veja [Re-use OpenID Tokens for Login Session](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/token-reuse).

## Avançado: Integração com a Microsoft Graph API [#advanced-microsoft-graph-api-integration]

Ao usar o Azure Entra ID como seu provedor OpenID, você pode habilitar a integração com a Microsoft Graph API para aprimorar o sistema de permissões e compartilhamento com recursos de pesquisa de pessoas e grupos.

### Pré-requisitos [#prerequisites]

1. O seu registro de aplicativo Azure deve ter as permissões adequadas da Microsoft Graph API
2. O consentimento do administrador pode ser necessário para certos escopos da Graph API (como `GroupMember.Read.All`)

### Adicionando Permissões da Graph API [#adding-graph-api-permissions]

1. No seu registro de aplicativo Azure, vá para **API permissions**
2. Clique em **Add a permission** > **Microsoft Graph** > **Delegated permissions**
3. Adicione estas permissões:
   - `User.Read` - Entrar e ler o perfil do usuário
   - `People.Read` - Ler contatos do usuário
   - `GroupMember.Read.All` - Ler todas as associações de grupo
   - `User.ReadBasic.All` - Ler os perfis básicos de todos os usuários
4. Clique em **Grant admin consent** se necessário (você precisará de privilégios de administrador)

### Configuração [#configuration]

<Callout type="error" title="Obrigatório: Habilitar Reutilização de Token">
**Importante:** Você DEVE habilitar a reutilização de token OpenID para que este recurso funcione:
```bash filename=".env"
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
```
Veja [Configuração de Reutilização de Tokens](#advanced-token-reuse) acima para detalhes.
</Callout>

Adicione as seguintes variáveis de ambiente ao seu arquivo `.env`:

```bash filename=".env"
# Enable Entra ID people search in permissions/sharing
USE_ENTRA_ID_FOR_PEOPLE_SEARCH=true

# Include group owners as members when searching groups
ENTRA_ID_INCLUDE_OWNERS_AS_MEMBERS=true

# Microsoft Graph API scopes (these are automatically included with the OpenID scopes)
OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES=User.Read,People.Read,GroupMember.Read.All,User.ReadBasic.All
```

Quando ativado, o seletor de pessoas nas caixas de diálogo de permissões e compartilhamento irá:
- Pesquise usuários locais do LibreChat e usuários do Azure Entra ID
- Exibir perfis de usuário com nomes e e-mails da sua organização
- Permitir pesquisar e selecionar grupos do Azure Entra ID
- Exibir membros do grupo com base nas suas permissões da Graph API

### Notas [#notes]

- **A reutilização de tokens (`OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true`) é obrigatória** para que este recurso funcione
- Os `OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES` são anexados automaticamente ao seu `OPENID_SCOPE` existente durante a autenticação
- A pesquisa de grupo requer a permissão `GroupMember.Read.All`, que normalmente precisa de consentimento do administrador
- A pesquisa de usuários funciona com as permissões básicas `User.Read`, `People.Read` e `User.ReadBasic.All`

## Avançado: Integração com SharePoint [#advanced-sharepoint-integration]

O LibreChat pode ser integrado ao SharePoint Online e ao OneDrive for Business, permitindo que os usuários naveguem e anexem arquivos diretamente de suas bibliotecas do SharePoint.

### Pré-requisitos [#prerequisites-1]

1. Todos os requisitos de [Token Reuse](#advanced-token-reuse) devem ser atendidos
2. O seu registro de aplicativo Azure precisa de permissões adicionais do SharePoint
3. O seu registro de aplicativo Azure deve expor e conceder um escopo de API do LibreChat, como `api://<client-id>/access_as_user`

### Adicionando Permissões do SharePoint [#adding-sharepoint-permissions]

1. No seu registro de aplicativo Azure, vá para **API permissions**
2. Clique em **Add a permission**

#### Para acesso ao SharePoint: [#for-sharepoint-access]
3. Selecione **SharePoint** (não Microsoft Graph)
4. Escolha **Delegated permissions**
5. Adicionar: `AllSites.Read` - Ler itens em todas as coleções de sites

#### Para Downloads de Arquivos: [#for-file-downloads]
6. Clique em **Add a permission** novamente
7. Selecione **Microsoft Graph**
8. Escolha **Delegated permissions**
9. Adicionar: `Files.Read.All` - Ler todos os arquivos que o usuário pode acessar

10. Clique em **Grant admin consent** para ambas as permissões

### Configuração [#configuration-1]

Antes de habilitar as variáveis do SharePoint, certifique-se de que a configuração de reutilização de token OpenID solicite o escopo da API do aplicativo LibreChat. Isso fornece ao Azure um token de acesso de público-alvo do aplicativo que pode ser usado como a asserção on-behalf-of para a troca de tokens do SharePoint e do Graph.

```bash filename=".env"
# OpenID token reuse and OBO-compatible audience
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email offline_access api://<client-id>/access_as_user
OPENID_ON_BEHALF_FLOW_FOR_USERINFO_REQUIRED=true

# Enable SharePoint file picker
ENABLE_SHAREPOINT_FILEPICKER=true

# Your SharePoint tenant URL
SHAREPOINT_BASE_URL=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com

# SharePoint scope for file picker (replace 'yourtenant' with your actual tenant)
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_SHAREPOINT_SCOPE=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com/AllSites.Read

# Graph API scope for downloading files
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_GRAPH_SCOPE=Files.Read.All
```

### Uso [#usage]

Quando configurado corretamente:
1. Os usuários verão a opção "From SharePoint" no menu de anexos de arquivo
2. Clicar nele abre o seletor de arquivos nativo do SharePoint
3. Os usuários podem navegar e selecionar arquivos de qualquer site do SharePoint ou OneDrive ao qual tenham acesso
4. Os arquivos selecionados são baixados e anexados à conversa

<Callout type="warning" title="Nota de Segurança">
A integração com o SharePoint respeita todas as permissões existentes do SharePoint. Os usuários só podem acessar arquivos que eles já têm permissão para visualizar no SharePoint/OneDrive.
</Callout>

Para solução de problemas detalhada e configuração avançada, consulte: [SharePoint Integration Guide](/docs/configuration/sharepoint)

> Not: Docker kullanıyorsanız, .env yapılandırma değişikliklerini uygulamak için `docker compose up -d` komutunu çalıştırın.

## Gelişmiş: Token Yeniden Kullanımı [#advanced-token-reuse]

LibreChat, oturum yönetimi için Azure Entra ID belirteçlerinin (token) yeniden kullanımını destekler; bu da Azure ortamınızla daha iyi bir entegrasyon sağlayabilir. Bu özellik, LibreChat'in kendi oturum belirteçlerini yönetmek yerine Azure'un yenileme belirteçlerini kullanmasına olanak tanır.

Bu özellik ve nasıl yapılandırılacağı hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinmek için [Re-use OpenID Tokens for Login Session](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/token-reuse) bölümüne bakın.

## Gelişmiş: Microsoft Graph API Entegrasyonu [#advanced-microsoft-graph-api-integration]

Azure Entra ID'yi OpenID sağlayıcınız olarak kullanırken, izinleri ve paylaşım sistemini kişi ve grup arama yetenekleriyle geliştirmek için Microsoft Graph API entegrasyonunu etkinleştirebilirsiniz.

### Ön Koşullar [#prerequisites]

1. Azure uygulama kaydınızın uygun Microsoft Graph API izinlerine sahip olması gerekir
2. Belirli Graph API kapsamları (örneğin `GroupMember.Read.All`) için yönetici onayı gerekebilir.

### Graph API İzinlerini Ekleme [#adding-graph-api-permissions]

1. Azure uygulama kaydınızda **API permissions** kısmına gidin
2. **İzin ekle** (Add a permission) > **Microsoft Graph** > **Temsilci izinleri** (Delegated permissions) öğesine tıklayın
3. Şu izinleri ekleyin:
   - `User.Read` - Oturum açın ve kullanıcı profilini okuyun
   - `People.Read` - Kullanıcı kişilerini oku
   - `GroupMember.Read.All` - Tüm grup üyeliklerini oku
   - `User.ReadBasic.All` - Tüm kullanıcıların temel profillerini oku
4. Gerekirse **Grant admin consent** seçeneğine tıklayın (yönetici ayrıcalıklarına sahip olmanız gerekecektir)

### Yapılandırma [#configuration]

<Callout type="error" title="Gerekli: Token Yeniden Kullanımını Etkinleştir">
**Önemli:** Bu özelliğin çalışması için OpenID token yeniden kullanımını (token reuse) etkinleştirmeniz GEREKİR:
```bash filename=".env"
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
```
Ayrıntılar için yukarıdaki [Token Reuse Configuration](#advanced-token-reuse) bölümüne bakın.
</Callout>

`.env` dosyanıza aşağıdaki ortam değişkenlerini ekleyin:

```bash filename=".env"
# Enable Entra ID people search in permissions/sharing
USE_ENTRA_ID_FOR_PEOPLE_SEARCH=true

# Include group owners as members when searching groups
ENTRA_ID_INCLUDE_OWNERS_AS_MEMBERS=true

# Microsoft Graph API scopes (these are automatically included with the OpenID scopes)
OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES=User.Read,People.Read,GroupMember.Read.All,User.ReadBasic.All
```

Etkinleştirildiğinde, izinler ve paylaşım iletişim kutularındaki kişi seçici şunları yapacaktır:
- Hem yerel LibreChat kullanıcılarını hem de Azure Entra ID kullanıcılarını arayın
- Kuruluşunuzdaki kullanıcı profillerini adları ve e-posta adresleriyle görüntüleyin
- Azure Entra ID gruplarını aramaya ve seçmeye izin ver
- Graph API izinlerinize göre grup üyelerini göster

### Notlar [#notes]

- Bu özelliğin çalışması için **Token yeniden kullanımı (`OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true`) zorunludur**
- `OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES`, kimlik doğrulama sırasında mevcut `OPENID_SCOPE` değerinize otomatik olarak eklenir.
- Grup araması, genellikle yönetici onayı gerektiren `GroupMember.Read.All` iznini gerektirir.
- Kullanıcı araması, temel `User.Read`, `People.Read` ve `User.ReadBasic.All` izinleriyle çalışır

## Gelişmiş: SharePoint Entegrasyonu [#advanced-sharepoint-integration]

LibreChat, SharePoint Online ve OneDrive for Business ile entegre olabilir; bu sayede kullanıcılar dosyalarına doğrudan SharePoint kütüphanelerinden göz atabilir ve ekleyebilirler.

### Ön Koşullar [#prerequisites-1]

1. [Token Reuse](#advanced-token-reuse) bölümündeki tüm gereksinimler karşılanmalıdır
2. Azure uygulama kaydınızın ek SharePoint izinlerine ihtiyacı var
3. Azure uygulama kaydınız, `api://<client-id>/access_as_user` gibi bir LibreChat API kapsamını açığa çıkarmalı ve buna izin vermelidir.

### SharePoint İzinlerini Ekleme [#adding-sharepoint-permissions]

1. Azure uygulama kaydınızda **API permissions** kısmına gidin
2. **İzin ekle**'ye tıklayın

#### SharePoint Erişimi İçin: [#for-sharepoint-access]
3. **SharePoint**'i seçin (Microsoft Graph değil)
4. **Temsil edilen izinleri** (Delegated permissions) seçin
5. Ekle: `AllSites.Read` - Tüm site koleksiyonlarındaki öğeleri oku

#### Dosya İndirmeleri İçin: [#for-file-downloads]
6. Tekrar **Add a permission** düğmesine tıklayın
7. **Microsoft Graph** öğesini seçin
8. **Temsil edilen izinleri** (Delegated permissions) seçin
9. Ekle: `Files.Read.All` - Kullanıcının erişebildiği tüm dosyaları oku

10. Her iki izin için de **Grant admin consent** seçeneğine tıklayın

### Yapılandırma [#configuration-1]

SharePoint değişkenlerini etkinleştirmeden önce, OpenID belirteci yeniden kullanım yapılandırmasının LibreChat uygulama API kapsamını talep ettiğinden emin olun. Bu, Azure'a SharePoint ve Graph belirteç değişimi için "adına hareket etme" (on-behalf-of) iddiası olarak kullanılabilecek bir uygulama hedef kitlesi erişim belirteci sağlar.

```bash filename=".env"
# OpenID token reuse and OBO-compatible audience
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email offline_access api://<client-id>/access_as_user
OPENID_ON_BEHALF_FLOW_FOR_USERINFO_REQUIRED=true

# Enable SharePoint file picker
ENABLE_SHAREPOINT_FILEPICKER=true

# Your SharePoint tenant URL
SHAREPOINT_BASE_URL=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com

# SharePoint scope for file picker (replace 'yourtenant' with your actual tenant)
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_SHAREPOINT_SCOPE=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com/AllSites.Read

# Graph API scope for downloading files
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_GRAPH_SCOPE=Files.Read.All
```

### Kullanım [#usage]

Düzgün bir şekilde yapılandırıldığında:
1. Kullanıcılar dosya ekleme menüsünde "From SharePoint" seçeneğini göreceklerdir
2. Buna tıklamak, yerel SharePoint dosya seçicisini açar
3. Kullanıcılar, erişim izinlerinin olduğu herhangi bir SharePoint sitesinden veya OneDrive'dan dosyalara göz atabilir ve seçim yapabilirler.
4. Seçilen dosyalar indirilir ve konuşmaya eklenir

<Callout type="warning" title="Güvenlik Notu">
SharePoint entegrasyonu, mevcut tüm SharePoint izinlerine uyar. Kullanıcılar yalnızca SharePoint/OneDrive üzerinde görüntüleme iznine sahip oldukları dosyalara erişebilirler.
</Callout>

Ayrıntılı sorun giderme ve gelişmiş yapılandırma için bkz: [SharePoint Integration Guide](/docs/configuration/sharepoint)

# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/azure.vi.mdx

title: Azure Entra
icon: Azure
description: >-
  Tìm hiểu cách cấu hình LibreChat để sử dụng Azure Entra cho xác thực người
  dùng.

1. Truy cập [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/) và đăng nhập bằng tài khoản của bạn.
2. Trong hộp tìm kiếm, hãy nhập "Azure Entra" và nhấp vào đó.
3. Trên menu bên trái, nhấp vào App registrations và sau đó nhấp vào New registration.
4. Đặt tên cho ứng dụng của bạn và chọn Web làm loại nền tảng.
5. Trong trường Redirect URI, hãy nhập URL callback OpenID của LibreChat và nhấp vào Register. Đối với các bản cài đặt Docker cục bộ, hãy sử dụng `http://localhost:3080/oauth/openid/callback`. Đối với các instance đã triển khai, hãy thay thế `http://localhost:3080` bằng giá trị `DOMAIN_SERVER` công khai của bạn, ví dụ: `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/2b1aabce-850e-4165-bf76-3c1984f10b6c)

6. Bạn sẽ thấy trang Overview với một số thông tin về ứng dụng của mình. Hãy sao chép Application (client) ID và Directory (tenant) ID rồi lưu chúng lại ở đâu đó.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/e67d5e97-e26d-48a5-aa6e-50de4450b1fd)

7. Trên menu bên trái, nhấp vào Authentication và chọn các ô cho Access tokens và ID tokens trong phần Implicit grant and hybrid flows.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/88a16cbc-ff68-4b3a-ba7b-b380cc3d2366)

8. Trên menu bên trái, hãy nhấp vào Certificates & Secrets và sau đó nhấp vào New client secret. Đặt tên cho secret của bạn và chọn ngày hết hạn, sau đó nhấp vào Add. Bạn sẽ thấy cột Value chứa secret của mình. Hãy sao chép và lưu nó ở một nơi an toàn. Đừng chia sẻ nó với bất kỳ ai!

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/31aa6cee-5402-4ce0-a950-1b7e147aafc8)

9. Nếu bạn muốn hạn chế quyền truy cập theo nhóm, bạn nên thêm claim groups vào token. Để thực hiện việc này, hãy đi tới Token configuration và nhấp vào Add group claim. Chọn các nhóm bạn muốn đưa vào token và nhấp vào Add.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/c9d353f5-2cb2-4f00-b4f0-493cfec8fe9a)

10. Mở tệp .env trong thư mục dự án của bạn và thêm các biến sau với các giá trị bạn đã sao chép:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page
ALLOW_SOCIAL_LOGIN=true

OPENID_CLIENT_ID=Your Application (client) ID
OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET=Your client secret
OPENID_ISSUER=https://login.microsoftonline.com/Your Directory (tenant ID)/v2.0/
OPENID_SESSION_SECRET=Any random string
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email #DO NOT CHANGE THIS
OPENID_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/openid/callback # this should be the same for everyone

OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_TOKEN_KIND=id

# If you want to restrict access by groups
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_PARAMETER_PATH="roles"
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE="Your Group Name" # Single role or comma-separated roles (e.g., Group1,Group2,Admin)

# Optional: redirects the user to the end session endpoint after logging out
OPENID_USE_END_SESSION_ENDPOINT=true

# Maximum logout URL length before using logout_hint instead of id_token_hint (default: 2000)
# OPENID_MAX_LOGOUT_URL_LENGTH=2000
```

URI chuyển hướng được đăng ký trong Azure phải khớp chính xác với URL mà LibreChat sử dụng. Nếu `DOMAIN_SERVER=https://chat.example.com`, Azure sẽ cần sử dụng `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`.

11. Lưu tệp .env

> Lưu ý: Nếu sử dụng Docker, hãy chạy `docker compose up -d` để áp dụng các thay đổi cấu hình trong .env

## Nâng cao: Tái sử dụng Token [#advanced-token-reuse]

LibreChat hỗ trợ việc tái sử dụng token Azure Entra ID để quản lý phiên làm việc, điều này có thể mang lại khả năng tích hợp tốt hơn với môi trường Azure của bạn. Tính năng này cho phép LibreChat sử dụng các refresh token của Azure thay vì tự quản lý các token phiên của riêng mình.

Để tìm hiểu thêm về tính năng này và cách cấu hình, hãy xem [Re-use OpenID Tokens for Login Session](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/token-reuse).

## Nâng cao: Tích hợp Microsoft Graph API [#advanced-microsoft-graph-api-integration]

Khi sử dụng Azure Entra ID làm nhà cung cấp OpenID của bạn, bạn có thể kích hoạt tích hợp Microsoft Graph API để nâng cao hệ thống quyền và chia sẻ với các khả năng tìm kiếm người dùng và nhóm.

### Điều kiện tiên quyết [#prerequisites]

1. Ứng dụng Azure của bạn phải có các quyền Microsoft Graph API phù hợp
2. Có thể cần sự đồng ý của quản trị viên đối với một số phạm vi Graph API nhất định (như `GroupMember.Read.All`)

### Thêm quyền Graph API [#adding-graph-api-permissions]

1. Trong phần đăng ký ứng dụng Azure của bạn, hãy đi tới **API permissions**
2. Nhấp vào **Add a permission** > **Microsoft Graph** > **Delegated permissions**
3. Thêm các quyền này:
   - `User.Read` - Đăng nhập và đọc hồ sơ người dùng
   - `People.Read` - Đọc danh bạ người dùng
   - `GroupMember.Read.All` - Đọc tất cả các tư cách thành viên nhóm
   - `User.ReadBasic.All` - Đọc hồ sơ cơ bản của tất cả người dùng
4. Nhấp vào **Grant admin consent** nếu được yêu cầu (bạn sẽ cần quyền quản trị viên)

### Cấu hình [#configuration]

<Callout type="error" title="Bắt buộc: Bật tính năng Tái sử dụng Token">
**Quan trọng:** Bạn BẮT BUỘC phải bật tính năng tái sử dụng mã thông báo OpenID để tính năng này hoạt động:
```bash filename=".env"
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
```
Xem [Cấu hình Tái sử dụng Token](#advanced-token-reuse) ở trên để biết chi tiết.
</Callout>

Thêm các biến môi trường sau vào tệp `.env` của bạn:

```bash filename=".env"
# Enable Entra ID people search in permissions/sharing
USE_ENTRA_ID_FOR_PEOPLE_SEARCH=true

# Include group owners as members when searching groups
ENTRA_ID_INCLUDE_OWNERS_AS_MEMBERS=true

# Microsoft Graph API scopes (these are automatically included with the OpenID scopes)
OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES=User.Read,People.Read,GroupMember.Read.All,User.ReadBasic.All
```

Khi được bật, trình chọn người dùng trong các hộp thoại cấp quyền và chia sẻ sẽ:
- Tìm kiếm cả người dùng LibreChat cục bộ và người dùng Azure Entra ID
- Hiển thị hồ sơ người dùng với tên và email từ tổ chức của bạn
- Cho phép tìm kiếm và chọn các nhóm Azure Entra ID
- Hiển thị các thành viên trong nhóm dựa trên quyền Graph API của bạn

### Ghi chú [#notes]

- **Việc sử dụng lại token (`OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true`) là bắt buộc** để tính năng này hoạt động
- `OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES` sẽ được tự động thêm vào `OPENID_SCOPE` hiện có của bạn trong quá trình xác thực.
- Tính năng tìm kiếm nhóm yêu cầu quyền `GroupMember.Read.All`, quyền này thường cần sự đồng ý của quản trị viên.
- Tính năng tìm kiếm người dùng hoạt động với các quyền cơ bản `User.Read`, `People.Read` và `User.ReadBasic.All`

## Nâng cao: Tích hợp SharePoint [#advanced-sharepoint-integration]

LibreChat có thể tích hợp với SharePoint Online và OneDrive for Business, cho phép người dùng duyệt và đính kèm tệp trực tiếp từ các thư viện SharePoint của họ.

### Điều kiện tiên quyết [#prerequisites-1]

1. Tất cả các yêu cầu từ [Token Reuse](#advanced-token-reuse) phải được đáp ứng
2. Ứng dụng Azure của bạn cần thêm quyền SharePoint
3. Việc đăng ký ứng dụng Azure của bạn phải hiển thị và cấp quyền phạm vi (scope) API cho LibreChat, ví dụ như `api://<client-id>/access_as_user`

### Thêm quyền SharePoint [#adding-sharepoint-permissions]

1. Trong phần đăng ký ứng dụng Azure của bạn, hãy đi tới **API permissions**
2. Nhấp vào **Add a permission**

#### Đối với quyền truy cập SharePoint: [#for-sharepoint-access]
3. Chọn **SharePoint** (không phải Microsoft Graph)
4. Chọn **Delegated permissions**
5. Thêm: `AllSites.Read` - Đọc các mục trong tất cả các tập hợp trang web

#### Đối với Tải xuống Tệp: [#for-file-downloads]
6. Nhấp vào **Add a permission** một lần nữa
7. Chọn **Microsoft Graph**
8. Chọn **Delegated permissions**
9. Thêm: `Files.Read.All` - Đọc tất cả các tệp mà người dùng có thể truy cập

10. Nhấp vào **Grant admin consent** cho cả hai quyền.

### Cấu hình [#configuration-1]

Trước khi kích hoạt các biến SharePoint, hãy đảm bảo cấu hình tái sử dụng mã thông báo OpenID yêu cầu phạm vi API của ứng dụng LibreChat. Điều này cung cấp cho Azure một mã thông báo truy cập dành cho đối tượng ứng dụng, có thể được sử dụng làm xác nhận on-behalf-of cho việc trao đổi mã thông báo SharePoint và Graph.

```bash filename=".env"
# OpenID token reuse and OBO-compatible audience
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email offline_access api://<client-id>/access_as_user
OPENID_ON_BEHALF_FLOW_FOR_USERINFO_REQUIRED=true

# Enable SharePoint file picker
ENABLE_SHAREPOINT_FILEPICKER=true

# Your SharePoint tenant URL
SHAREPOINT_BASE_URL=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com

# SharePoint scope for file picker (replace 'yourtenant' with your actual tenant)
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_SHAREPOINT_SCOPE=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com/AllSites.Read

# Graph API scope for downloading files
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_GRAPH_SCOPE=Files.Read.All
```

### Cách sử dụng [#usage]

Khi được cấu hình đúng cách:
1. Người dùng sẽ thấy tùy chọn "From SharePoint" trong menu đính kèm tệp.
2. Nhấp vào đó sẽ mở trình chọn tệp SharePoint gốc
3. Người dùng có thể duyệt và chọn tệp từ bất kỳ trang SharePoint hoặc OneDrive nào mà họ có quyền truy cập
4. Các tệp đã chọn được tải xuống và đính kèm vào cuộc trò chuyện

<Callout type="warning" title="Lưu ý về bảo mật">
Tích hợp SharePoint tôn trọng tất cả các quyền hiện có trên SharePoint. Người dùng chỉ có thể truy cập các tệp mà họ đã có quyền xem trong SharePoint/OneDrive.
</Callout>

Để biết chi tiết về khắc phục sự cố và cấu hình nâng cao, hãy xem: [SharePoint Integration Guide](/docs/configuration/sharepoint)

---

# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/azure.zh.mdx

title: Azure Entra
icon: Azure
description: 了解如何配置 LibreChat 以使用 Azure Entra 进行用户身份验证。

1. 前往 [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com/) 并使用您的账户登录。
2. 在搜索框中输入 "Azure Entra" 并点击它。
3. 在左侧菜单中，点击 App registrations，然后点击 New registration。
4. 为您的应用命名，并选择 Web 作为平台类型。
5. 在 Redirect URI 字段中，输入您的 LibreChat OpenID 回调 URL 并点击 Register。对于本地 Docker 安装，请使用 `http://localhost:3080/oauth/openid/callback`。对于已部署的实例，请将 `http://localhost:3080` 替换为您公共的 `DOMAIN_SERVER` 值，例如 `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/2b1aabce-850e-4165-bf76-3c1984f10b6c)

6. 您将看到一个包含有关您的应用程序信息的概览页面。请复制应用程序（客户端）ID 和目录（租户）ID 并将其保存到某处。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/e67d5e97-e26d-48a5-aa6e-50de4450b1fd)

7. 在左侧菜单中，点击 Authentication，然后在 Implicit grant and hybrid flows 下勾选 Access tokens 和 ID tokens。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/88a16cbc-ff68-4b3a-ba7b-b380cc3d2366)

8. 在左侧菜单中，点击 Certificates & Secrets，然后点击 New client secret。为您的密钥命名并设置过期日期，然后点击 Add。您将看到一个包含密钥的 Value 列。请将其复制并妥善保存。切勿与他人分享！

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/31aa6cee-5402-4ce0-a950-1b7e147aafc8)

9. 如果您想通过组来限制访问，则应将 groups 声明添加到令牌中。为此，请转到 Token configuration 并点击 Add group claim。选择您想要包含在令牌中的组，然后点击 Add。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/c9d353f5-2cb2-4f00-b4f0-493cfec8fe9a)

10. 打开项目文件夹中的 .env 文件，并添加以下变量及其对应的值：

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

# enable social login or else OpenID button will not appear on login page
ALLOW_SOCIAL_LOGIN=true

OPENID_CLIENT_ID=Your Application (client) ID
OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET=Your client secret
OPENID_ISSUER=https://login.microsoftonline.com/Your Directory (tenant ID)/v2.0/
OPENID_SESSION_SECRET=Any random string
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email #DO NOT CHANGE THIS
OPENID_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/openid/callback # this should be the same for everyone

OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_TOKEN_KIND=id

# If you want to restrict access by groups
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_PARAMETER_PATH="roles"
OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE="Your Group Name" # Single role or comma-separated roles (e.g., Group1,Group2,Admin)

# Optional: redirects the user to the end session endpoint after logging out
OPENID_USE_END_SESSION_ENDPOINT=true

# Maximum logout URL length before using logout_hint instead of id_token_hint (default: 2000)
# OPENID_MAX_LOGOUT_URL_LENGTH=2000
```

在 Azure 中注册的重定向 URI 必须与 LibreChat 提供的 URL 完全一致。如果 `DOMAIN_SERVER=https://chat.example.com`，则 Azure 应使用 `https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback`。

11. 保存 .env 文件

> 注意：如果使用 Docker，请运行 `docker compose up -d` 以应用 .env 配置更改。

## 进阶：Token 重用 [#advanced-token-reuse]

LibreChat 支持重用 Azure Entra ID 令牌进行会话管理，这可以提供与您的 Azure 环境更好的集成。此功能允许 LibreChat 使用 Azure 的刷新令牌，而不是管理其自己的会话令牌。

要了解有关此功能的更多信息以及如何配置它，请参阅 [Re-use OpenID Tokens for Login Session](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/token-reuse)。

## 进阶：Microsoft Graph API 集成 [#advanced-microsoft-graph-api-integration]

当使用 Azure Entra ID 作为您的 OpenID 提供商时，您可以启用 Microsoft Graph API 集成，以通过人员和群组搜索功能增强权限和共享系统。

### 先决条件 [#prerequisites]

1. 您的 Azure 应用注册必须具备相应的 Microsoft Graph API 权限
2. 某些 Graph API 范围（例如 `GroupMember.Read.All`）可能需要管理员同意。

### 添加 Graph API 权限 [#adding-graph-api-permissions]

1. 在您的 Azure 应用注册中，转到 **API permissions**
2. 点击 **Add a permission** > **Microsoft Graph** > **Delegated permissions**
3. 添加这些权限：
   - `User.Read` - 登录并读取用户个人资料
   - `People.Read` - 读取用户联系人
   - `GroupMember.Read.All` - 读取所有组成员身份
   - `User.ReadBasic.All` - 读取所有用户的基本资料
4. 如果需要，请点击 **Grant admin consent**（你需要具备管理员权限）

### 配置 [#configuration]

<Callout type="error" title="必需：启用令牌重用">
**重要提示：** 您必须启用 OpenID 令牌重用（token reuse）此功能才能正常工作：
```bash filename=".env"
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
```
请参阅上方的 [Token Reuse Configuration](#advanced-token-reuse) 以了解详情。
</Callout>

将以下环境变量添加到您的 `.env` 文件中：

```bash filename=".env"
# Enable Entra ID people search in permissions/sharing
USE_ENTRA_ID_FOR_PEOPLE_SEARCH=true

# Include group owners as members when searching groups
ENTRA_ID_INCLUDE_OWNERS_AS_MEMBERS=true

# Microsoft Graph API scopes (these are automatically included with the OpenID scopes)
OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES=User.Read,People.Read,GroupMember.Read.All,User.ReadBasic.All
```

启用后，权限和共享对话框中的人员选择器将：
- 同时搜索本地 LibreChat 用户和 Azure Entra ID 用户
- 显示来自您组织的用户个人资料，包含姓名和电子邮件
- 允许搜索并选择 Azure Entra ID 组
- 根据您的 Graph API 权限显示组成员

### 注意事项 [#notes]

- **Token reuse (`OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true`) 是此功能正常工作的必要条件**
- `OPENID_GRAPH_SCOPES` 会在身份验证期间自动附加到您现有的 `OPENID_SCOPE` 中。
- 群组搜索需要 `GroupMember.Read.All` 权限，这通常需要管理员同意。
- 用户搜索功能需要基本的 `User.Read`、`People.Read` 和 `User.ReadBasic.All` 权限。

## 进阶：SharePoint 集成 [#advanced-sharepoint-integration]

LibreChat 可以与 SharePoint Online 和 OneDrive for Business 集成，允许用户直接从其 SharePoint 库中浏览和附加文件。

### 先决条件 [#prerequisites-1]

1. 必须满足 [Token Reuse](#advanced-token-reuse) 中的所有要求
2. 您的 Azure 应用注册需要额外的 SharePoint 权限
3. 您的 Azure 应用注册必须公开并授予一个 LibreChat API 范围，例如 `api://<client-id>/access_as_user`

### 添加 SharePoint 权限 [#adding-sharepoint-permissions]

1. 在您的 Azure 应用注册中，转到 **API permissions**
2. 点击 **Add a permission**

#### 对于 SharePoint 访问： [#for-sharepoint-access]
3. 选择 **SharePoint**（而非 Microsoft Graph）
4. 选择 **Delegated permissions**
5. 添加：`AllSites.Read` - 读取所有网站集中的项目

#### 关于文件下载： [#for-file-downloads]
6. 再次点击 **Add a permission**
7. 选择 **Microsoft Graph**
8. 选择 **Delegated permissions**
9. 添加：`Files.Read.All` - 读取用户可访问的所有文件

10. 点击 **Grant admin consent** 以授予这两个权限

### 配置 [#configuration-1]

在启用 SharePoint 变量之前，请确保 OpenID 令牌重用配置请求了 LibreChat 应用 API 作用域。这会为 Azure 提供一个应用受众访问令牌，该令牌可用作 SharePoint 和 Graph 令牌交换的代表（on-behalf-of）断言。

```bash filename=".env"
# OpenID token reuse and OBO-compatible audience
OPENID_REUSE_TOKENS=true
OPENID_SCOPE=openid profile email offline_access api://<client-id>/access_as_user
OPENID_ON_BEHALF_FLOW_FOR_USERINFO_REQUIRED=true

# Enable SharePoint file picker
ENABLE_SHAREPOINT_FILEPICKER=true

# Your SharePoint tenant URL
SHAREPOINT_BASE_URL=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com

# SharePoint scope for file picker (replace 'yourtenant' with your actual tenant)
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_SHAREPOINT_SCOPE=https://yourtenant.sharepoint.com/AllSites.Read

# Graph API scope for downloading files
SHAREPOINT_PICKER_GRAPH_SCOPE=Files.Read.All
```

### 使用方法 [#usage]

在正确配置后：
1. 用户将在文件附件菜单中看到“From SharePoint”选项
2. 点击它会打开原生的 SharePoint 文件选择器
3. 用户可以浏览并选择他们有权访问的任何 SharePoint 站点或 OneDrive 中的文件
4. 选定的文件已下载并附加到对话中

<Callout type="warning" title="安全提示">
SharePoint 集成遵循所有现有的 SharePoint 权限。用户只能访问他们在 SharePoint/OneDrive 中已有权查看的文件。
</Callout>

有关详细的故障排除和高级配置，请参阅：[SharePoint 集成指南](/docs/configuration/sharepoint)

---

# discord.de.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/discord.de.mdx

title: Discord
icon: Discord
description: >-
  Erfahren Sie, wie Sie LibreChat für die Benutzerauthentifizierung mit Discord
  konfigurieren.

## Erstellen einer neuen Discord-Anwendung [#create-a-new-discord-application]

- Gehen Sie zum **[Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers)**

- Erstellen Sie eine neue Application und geben Sie ihr einen Namen

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/7e7cdfa0-d1d6-4b6b-a8a9-905aaa40d135)

## Konfiguration der Discord-Anwendung [#discord-application-configuration]

- Fügen Sie in den allgemeinen OAuth2-Einstellungen eine gültige Redirect-URL hinzu:
    - Beispiel für localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/discord/callback`
    - Beispiel für eine Domain: `https://example.com/oauth/discord/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/6c56fb92-f4ab-43b9-981b-f98babeeb19d)

- Wählen Sie unter `Default Authorization Link` die Option `In-app Authorization` und setzen Sie die Scopes auf `applications.commands`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ce94670-9422-48d2-97e9-ec40bd331573)

- Änderungen speichern und das Client Secret zurücksetzen

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3af164fc-66ed-4e5e-9f5a-9bcab3df37b4)
![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ece3935-68e6-4f2e-8656-9721cba5388a)

## .env Konfiguration [#env-configuration]

- Fügen Sie Ihre `Client ID` und Ihr `Client Secret` in die `.env` Datei ein:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/discord/callback
```

- Speichern Sie die `.env` Datei

> Hinweis: Wenn Sie Docker verwenden, führen Sie `docker compose up -d` aus, um die Konfigurationsänderungen in der .env anzuwenden.

    - localhostの例: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/discord/callback`
    - ドメインの例: `https://example.com/oauth/discord/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/6c56fb92-f4ab-43b9-981b-f98babeeb19d)

- `Default Authorization Link` で `In-app Authorization` を選択し、スコープを `applications.commands` に設定します。

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/discord/callback
```

- `.env` ファイルを保存します

    - Przykład dla localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/discord/callback`
    - Przykład dla domeny: `https://example.com/oauth/discord/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ce94670-9422-48d2-97e9-ec40bd331573)

- Zapisz zmiany i zresetuj Client Secret

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3af164fc-66ed-4e5e-9f5a-9bcab3df37b4)
![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ece3935-68e6-4f2e-8656-9721cba5388a)

## Konfiguracja .env [#env-configuration]

- Wklej swój `Client ID` oraz `Client Secret` w pliku `.env`:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/discord/callback
```

- Zapisz plik `.env`

> Uwaga: Jeśli używasz Docker, uruchom `docker compose up -d`, aby zastosować zmiany w konfiguracji .env

# discord.pt-BR.mdx

title: Discord
icon: Discord
description: >-
  Aprenda a configurar o LibreChat para usar o Discord para autenticação de
  usuários.

## Criar um novo Discord Application [#create-a-new-discord-application]

- Vá para o **[Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers)**

- Crie um novo Application e dê a ele um nome

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/7e7cdfa0-d1d6-4b6b-a8a9-905aaa40d135)

## Configuração do Aplicativo Discord [#discord-application-configuration]

- Nas configurações gerais do OAuth2, adicione uma URL de redirecionamento válida:
    - Exemplo para localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/discord/callback`
    - Exemplo para um domínio: `https://example.com/oauth/discord/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/6c56fb92-f4ab-43b9-981b-f98babeeb19d)

- Em `Default Authorization Link`, selecione `In-app Authorization` e defina os escopos como `applications.commands`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ce94670-9422-48d2-97e9-ec40bd331573)

- Salve as alterações e redefina o Client Secret

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3af164fc-66ed-4e5e-9f5a-9bcab3df37b4)
![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ece3935-68e6-4f2e-8656-9721cba5388a)

## Configuração do .env [#env-configuration]

- Cole o seu `Client ID` e `Client Secret` no arquivo `.env`:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/discord/callback
```

- Salve o arquivo `.env`

> Nota: Se estiver usando Docker, execute `docker compose up -d` para aplicar as alterações de configuração do .env

title: Discord

description: >-

  yapılandıracağınızı öğrenin.

- Yeni bir Uygulama oluşturun ve bir ad verin

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/7e7cdfa0-d1d6-4b6b-a8a9-905aaa40d135)

## Discord Uygulama Yapılandırması [#discord-application-configuration]

- OAuth2 genel ayarlarında geçerli bir yönlendirme URL'si ekleyin:
    - localhost için örnek: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/discord/callback`
    - Bir alan adı için örnek: `https://example.com/oauth/discord/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/6c56fb92-f4ab-43b9-981b-f98babeeb19d)

- `Default Authorization Link` içinde `In-app Authorization` seçeneğini belirleyin ve kapsamları (scopes) `applications.commands` olarak ayarlayın.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ce94670-9422-48d2-97e9-ec40bd331573)

- Değişiklikleri kaydet ve Client Secret'ı sıfırla

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3af164fc-66ed-4e5e-9f5a-9bcab3df37b4)
![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ece3935-68e6-4f2e-8656-9721cba5388a)

## .env Yapılandırması [#env-configuration]

- `Client ID` ve `Client Secret` bilgilerinizi `.env` dosyasına yapıştırın:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/discord/callback
```

- `.env` dosyasını kaydedin

> Not: Docker kullanıyorsanız, .env yapılandırma değişikliklerini uygulamak için `docker compose up -d` komutunu çalıştırın.

# discord.vi.mdx

title: Discord
icon: Discord
description: Tìm hiểu cách cấu hình LibreChat để sử dụng Discord cho xác thực người dùng.

## Tạo một Discord Application mới [#create-a-new-discord-application]

- Truy cập **[Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers)**

- Tạo một Application mới và đặt tên cho nó

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/7e7cdfa0-d1d6-4b6b-a8a9-905aaa40d135)

## Cấu hình ứng dụng Discord [#discord-application-configuration]

- Trong cài đặt chung của OAuth2, hãy thêm một redirect URL hợp lệ:
    - Ví dụ cho localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/discord/callback`
    - Ví dụ cho một tên miền: `https://example.com/oauth/discord/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/6c56fb92-f4ab-43b9-981b-f98babeeb19d)

- Trong `Default Authorization Link`, chọn `In-app Authorization` và đặt các phạm vi (scopes) thành `applications.commands`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ce94670-9422-48d2-97e9-ec40bd331573)

- Lưu các thay đổi và đặt lại Client Secret

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3af164fc-66ed-4e5e-9f5a-9bcab3df37b4)
![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ece3935-68e6-4f2e-8656-9721cba5388a)

## Cấu hình .env [#env-configuration]

- Dán `Client ID` và `Client Secret` của bạn vào tệp `.env`:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/discord/callback
```

- Lưu tệp `.env`

> Lưu ý: Nếu sử dụng Docker, hãy chạy `docker compose up -d` để áp dụng các thay đổi cấu hình trong .env

# discord.zh.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/discord.zh.mdx

title: Discord
icon: Discord
description: 了解如何配置 LibreChat 以使用 Discord 进行用户身份验证。

## 创建一个新的 Discord 应用程序 [#create-a-new-discord-application]

- 前往 **[Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers)**

- 创建一个新的 Application 并为其命名

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/7e7cdfa0-d1d6-4b6b-a8a9-905aaa40d135)

## Discord 应用程序配置 [#discord-application-configuration]

- 在 OAuth2 常规设置中添加一个有效的重定向 URL：
    - localhost 的示例：`http://localhost:3080/oauth/discord/callback`
    - 域名示例：`https://example.com/oauth/discord/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/6c56fb92-f4ab-43b9-981b-f98babeeb19d)

- 在 `Default Authorization Link` 中，选择 `In-app Authorization` 并将 scopes 设置为 `applications.commands`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ce94670-9422-48d2-97e9-ec40bd331573)

- 保存更改并重置 Client Secret

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3af164fc-66ed-4e5e-9f5a-9bcab3df37b4)
![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ece3935-68e6-4f2e-8656-9721cba5388a)

## .env 配置 [#env-configuration]

- 将您的 `Client ID` 和 `Client Secret` 粘贴到 `.env` 文件中：

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
DISCORD_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/discord/callback
```

- 保存 `.env` 文件

> 注意：如果使用 Docker，请运行 `docker compose up -d` 以应用 .env 配置更改。

# facebook.de.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/facebook.de.mdx

title: Facebook
icon: Facebook
description: >-
  Erfahren Sie, wie Sie LibreChat für die Benutzerauthentifizierung mit Facebook
  konfigurieren.

> ⚠️ **Warnung: Arbeit läuft, derzeit noch nicht funktionsfähig**

> ❗ Hinweis: Die Facebook-Authentifizierung funktioniert nicht von `localhost` aus

## Erstellen einer Facebook-Anwendung [#create-a-facebook-application]

- Gehe zum **[Facebook Developer Portal](https://developers.facebook.com/)**

- Klicken Sie im Kopfzeilenmenü auf "My Apps"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- Erstellen einer neuen Anwendung

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/706f050d-5423-44cc-80f0-120913695d8f)

- Wählen Sie „Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login“

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ebbb571-afe8-429e-ab39-be6e83d12c01)

- Wählen Sie „No, I'm not creating a game“

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/88b5160a-9c72-414a-bbcc-7717b81106f3)

- Geben Sie einen `app name` und eine `App contact email` an und klicken Sie auf `Create app`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Facebook-Anwendungskonfiguration [#facebook-application-configuration]

- Wählen Sie im Seitenmenü „Use cases“ aus und klicken Sie unter „Authentication and account creation“ auf „Customize“.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  Fügen Sie die `email permission` hinzu

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- Klicke jetzt auf `Go to settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login` und `Enforce HTTPS` **aktiviert** sind.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- Fügen Sie eine `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` hinzu und klicken Sie auf "Save changes"
    - Beispiel für eine Domain: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- Klicken Sie auf `Go back` und wählen Sie `Basic` im Tab `App settings` aus.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

- Klicken Sie neben dem App secret auf "Show".

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## .env Konfiguration [#env-configuration]

- Kopieren Sie die `App ID` und das `App Secret` und fügen Sie sie wie folgt in die `.env` Datei ein:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- Speichere die `.env` Datei.

> Hinweis: Wenn Sie Docker verwenden, führen Sie `docker compose up -d` aus, um die Konfigurationsänderungen in der .env anzuwenden.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- Buat aplikasi baru

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/706f050d-5423-44cc-80f0-120913695d8f)

- Pilih "Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ebbb571-afe8-429e-ab39-be6e83d12c01)

- Pilih "No, I'm not creating a game"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/88b5160a-9c72-414a-bbcc-7717b81106f3)

- Berikan `app name` dan `App contact email` lalu klik `Create app`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Konfigurasi Aplikasi Facebook [#facebook-application-configuration]

- Di menu samping, pilih "Use cases" dan klik "Customize" di bawah "Authentication and account creation."

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  Tambahkan `email permission`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- Sekarang klik `Go to settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- Pastikan `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login`, dan `Enforce HTTPS` telah **diaktifkan**.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- Tambahkan `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` dan "Save changes"
    - Contoh untuk domain: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- Klik `Go back` dan pilih `Basic` di tab `App settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

- Klik "Show" di samping App secret.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## Konfigurasi .env [#env-configuration]

- Salin `App ID` dan `App Secret` lalu tempelkan ke dalam file `.env` sebagai berikut:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- Simpan file `.env`.

> Catatan: Jika menggunakan Docker, jalankan `docker compose up -d` untuk menerapkan perubahan konfigurasi .env

## Crea un'applicazione Facebook [#create-a-facebook-application]

- Fai clic su "My Apps" nel menu dell'intestazione

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- Seleziona "Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login"

- Scegli "No, I'm not creating a game"

- Fornisci un `app name` e un `App contact email` e clicca su `Create app`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Configurazione dell'applicazione Facebook [#facebook-application-configuration]

- Nel menu laterale, seleziona "Use cases" e clicca su "Customize" sotto "Authentication and account creation."

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  Aggiungi l' `email permission`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- Ora clicca su `Go to settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- Assicurati che `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login` e `Enforce HTTPS` siano **abilitati**.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- Aggiungi un `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` e "Save changes"
    - Esempio per un dominio: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- Fai clic su `Go back` e seleziona `Basic` nella scheda `App settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## Configurazione di .env [#env-configuration]

- Copia l'`App ID` e l'`App Secret` e incollali nel file `.env` come segue:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- Salva il file `.env`.

> Nota: Se si utilizza Docker, eseguire `docker compose up -d` per applicare le modifiche alla configurazione nel file .env

# facebook.ja.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/facebook.ja.mdx

title: Facebook
icon: Facebook
description: LibreChatでユーザー認証にFacebookを使用するように設定する方法を学びます。

> ⚠️ **警告: 作業中であり、現在は機能しません**

> ❗ 注: Facebook認証は `localhost` からは動作しません

## Facebookアプリケーションを作成する [#create-a-facebook-application]

- **[Facebook Developer Portal](https://developers.facebook.com/)** にアクセスします。

- ヘッダーメニューの「My Apps」をクリックします

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- 新しいアプリケーションを作成する

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/706f050d-5423-44cc-80f0-120913695d8f)

- 「Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login」を選択します

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ebbb571-afe8-429e-ab39-be6e83d12c01)

- 「いいえ、ゲームを作成していません」を選択してください

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/88b5160a-9c72-414a-bbcc-7717b81106f3)

- `app name` と `App contact email` を入力し、`Create app` をクリックします。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Facebook アプリケーションの設定 [#facebook-application-configuration]

- サイドメニューで「Use cases」を選択し、「Authentication and account creation」の下にある「Customize」をクリックします。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  `email permission` を追加

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- 次に `Go to settings` をクリックします

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- `Client OAuth login`、`Web OAuth login`、および `Enforce HTTPS` が**有効**になっていることを確認してください。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` を追加し、「Save changes」をクリックします。
    - ドメインの例: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- `Go back` をクリックし、`App settings` タブで `Basic` を選択します。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

- App secret の横にある "Show" をクリックします。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## .env Configuration [#env-configuration]

- `App ID` と `App Secret` をコピーし、以下のように `.env` ファイルに貼り付けます：

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- `.env` ファイルを保存します。

> 注: Dockerを使用している場合は、`docker compose up -d` を実行して .env の設定変更を適用してください。

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/facebook.ko.mdx

title: Facebook
icon: Facebook
description: LibreChat에서 사용자 인증을 위해 Facebook을 구성하는 방법을 알아보세요.

> ⚠️ **경고: 작업 진행 중이며, 현재는 작동하지 않습니다**

> ❗ 참고: Facebook 인증은 `localhost`에서 작동하지 않습니다.

## Facebook 애플리케이션 만들기 [#create-a-facebook-application]

- **[Facebook Developer Portal](https://developers.facebook.com/)**로 이동하세요.

- 헤더 메뉴에서 "My Apps"를 클릭하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- 새 애플리케이션 만들기

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/706f050d-5423-44cc-80f0-120913695d8f)

- "Facebook Login을 사용하여 사용자를 인증하고 데이터를 요청"을 선택하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ebbb571-afe8-429e-ab39-be6e83d12c01)

- "No, I'm not creating a game"을 선택하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/88b5160a-9c72-414a-bbcc-7717b81106f3)

- `app name`과 `App contact email`을 입력하고 `Create app`을 클릭하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Facebook 애플리케이션 구성 [#facebook-application-configuration]

- 사이드 메뉴에서 "Use cases"를 선택하고 "Authentication and account creation" 아래의 "Customize"를 클릭하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  `email permission`을 추가하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- 이제 `Go to settings`를 클릭하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login` 및 `Enforce HTTPS`가 **활성화**되어 있는지 확인하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs`를 추가하고 "Save changes"를 클릭하세요.
    - 도메인 예시: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- `Go back`을 클릭하고 `App settings` 탭에서 `Basic`을 선택하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

- App secret 옆의 "Show"를 클릭하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## .env 구성 [#env-configuration]

- `App ID`와 `App Secret`을 복사하여 다음과 같이 `.env` 파일에 붙여넣으세요:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- `.env` 파일을 저장하세요.

> 참고: Docker를 사용하는 경우, `docker compose up -d`를 실행하여 .env 구성 변경 사항을 적용하세요.

title: Facebook
icon: Facebook
description: Learn how to configure LibreChat to use Facebook for user authentication.

> ⚠️ **Warning: Work in progress, not currently functional**

> ❗ Note: Facebook Authentication will not work from `localhost`

## Create a Facebook Application

- Go to the **[Facebook Developer Portal](https://developers.facebook.com/)**

- Click on "My Apps" in the header menu

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- Create a new application

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/706f050d-5423-44cc-80f0-120913695d8f)

- Select "Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ebbb571-afe8-429e-ab39-be6e83d12c01)

- Choose "No, I'm not creating a game"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/88b5160a-9c72-414a-bbcc-7717b81106f3)

- Provide an `app name` and `App contact email` and click `Create app`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Facebook Application Configuration

- In the side menu, select "Use cases" and click "Customize" under "Authentication and account creation."

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  Add the `email permission`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- Now click `Go to settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- Ensure that `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login` and `Enforce HTTPS` are **enabled**.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- Add a `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` and "Save changes"
    - Example for a domain: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- Click `Go back` and select `Basic` in the `App settings` tab

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

- Click "Show" next to the App secret.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## .env Configuration

- Copy the `App ID` and `App Secret` and paste them into the `.env` file as follows:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- Save the `.env` file.

> Note: If using docker, run `docker compose up -d` to apply the .env configuration changes

- Zorg ervoor dat `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login` en `Enforce HTTPS` zijn **ingeschakeld**.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- Voeg een `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` toe en "Save changes"
    - Voorbeeld voor een domein: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`
