- Kopieer de `App ID` en `App Secret` en plak ze als volgt in het `.env` bestand:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- Sla het `.env` bestand op.

> Let op: Als je Docker gebruikt, voer dan `docker compose up -d` uit om de wijzigingen in de .env configuratie toe te passen.

description: >-
  Dowiedz się, jak skonfigurować LibreChat, aby używać Facebooka do
  uwierzytelniania użytkowników.

> ⚠️ **Ostrzeżenie: Prace w toku, obecnie nie działa**

> ❗ Uwaga: Uwierzytelnianie przez Facebook nie będzie działać z `localhost`

## Utwórz aplikację Facebook [#create-a-facebook-application]

- Przejdź do **[Facebook Developer Portal](https://developers.facebook.com/)**

- Kliknij „My Apps” w menu nagłówka

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- Utwórz nową aplikację

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/706f050d-5423-44cc-80f0-120913695d8f)

- Wybierz "Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ebbb571-afe8-429e-ab39-be6e83d12c01)

- Wybierz "No, I'm not creating a game"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/88b5160a-9c72-414a-bbcc-7717b81106f3)

- Podaj `app name` oraz `App contact email` i kliknij `Create app`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Konfiguracja aplikacji Facebook [#facebook-application-configuration]

- W menu bocznym wybierz "Use cases" i kliknij "Customize" w sekcji "Authentication and account creation."

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  Dodaj `email permission`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- Teraz kliknij `Go to settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- Upewnij się, że `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login` oraz `Enforce HTTPS` są **włączone**.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- Dodaj `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` i „Save changes”
    - Przykład dla domeny: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- Kliknij `Go back` i wybierz `Basic` w zakładce `App settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

- Kliknij "Show" obok App secret.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## Konfiguracja .env [#env-configuration]

- Skopiuj `App ID` oraz `App Secret` i wklej je do pliku `.env` w następujący sposób:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- Zapisz plik `.env`.

> Uwaga: Jeśli używasz Docker, uruchom `docker compose up -d`, aby zastosować zmiany w konfiguracji .env

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- Salve o arquivo `.env`.

> Nota: Se estiver usando Docker, execute `docker compose up -d` para aplicar as alterações de configuração do .env

- Yan menüde "Use cases" seçeneğini belirleyin ve "Authentication and account creation" başlığı altındaki "Customize" düğmesine tıklayın.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  `email permission` ekleyin

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- Şimdi `Go to settings` öğesine tıklayın

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- `Client OAuth login`, `Web OAuth login` ve `Enforce HTTPS` seçeneklerinin **etkinleştirildiğinden** emin olun.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- Bir `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` ekleyin ve "Save changes" düğmesine tıklayın
    - Bir alan adı için örnek: `https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## .env Yapılandırması [#env-configuration]

- `App ID` ve `App Secret` değerlerini kopyalayın ve bunları `.env` dosyasına aşağıdaki gibi yapıştırın:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- `.env` dosyasını kaydedin.

> Not: Docker kullanıyorsanız, .env yapılandırma değişikliklerini uygulamak için `docker compose up -d` komutunu çalıştırın.

# facebook.zh.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/facebook.zh.mdx

title: Facebook
icon: Facebook
description: 了解如何配置 LibreChat 以使用 Facebook 进行用户身份验证。

> ⚠️ **警告：正在开发中，目前尚不可用**

> ❗ 注意：Facebook 身份验证无法在 `localhost` 上运行

## 创建 Facebook 应用程序 [#create-a-facebook-application]

- 前往 **[Facebook Developer Portal](https://developers.facebook.com/)**

- 点击页眉菜单中的 "My Apps"

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/b75ccb8b-d56b-41b7-8b0d-a32c2e762962)

- 创建新应用

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/706f050d-5423-44cc-80f0-120913695d8f)

- 选择“Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login”

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/2ebbb571-afe8-429e-ab39-be6e83d12c01)

- 选择“No, I'm not creating a game”

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/88b5160a-9c72-414a-bbcc-7717b81106f3)

- 提供 `app name` 和 `App contact email`，然后点击 `Create app`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/e1282c9e-4e7d-4cbe-82c9-cc76967f83e1)

## Facebook 应用程序配置 [#facebook-application-configuration]

- 在侧边菜单中，选择“Use cases”，然后点击“Authentication and account creation”下方的“Customize”。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/39f4bb70-d9dc-4d1c-8443-2666fe56499b)

-  添加 `email permission`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/dfa20879-2cb8-4daf-883d-3790854afca0)

- 现在点击 `Go to settings`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/512213a2-bd8b-4fd3-96c7-0de6d3222ddd)

- 确保 `Client OAuth login`、`Web OAuth login` 和 `Enforce HTTPS` 已**启用**。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/3a7d935b-97bf-493b-b909-39ecf9b3432b)

- 添加一个 `Valid OAuth Redirect URIs` 并点击“Save changes”
    - 域名示例：`https://example.com/oauth/facebook/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/ef8e54ee-a766-4871-9719-d4eff7a770b6)

- 点击 `Go back` 并在 `App settings` 选项卡中选择 `Basic`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/0d14f702-5183-422e-a12c-5d1b6031581b)

- 点击 App secret 旁边的 "Show"。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/32828263/9a009e37-2bb6-4da6-b5c7-9139c3db6185)

## .env 配置 [#env-configuration]

- 复制 `App ID` 和 `App Secret` 并将其粘贴到 `.env` 文件中，如下所示：

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID=your_app_id
FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=your_app_secret
FACEBOOK_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/facebook/callback
```

- 保存 `.env` 文件。

> 注意：如果使用 Docker，请运行 `docker compose up -d` 以应用 .env 配置更改。

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/github.de.mdx

title: GitHub
icon: Github
description: >-
  Erfahren Sie, wie Sie LibreChat für die Benutzerauthentifizierung mit GitHub
  konfigurieren.

## Erstellen einer GitHub-Anwendung [#create-a-github-application]

- Gehen Sie zu Ihren **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)**
- Erstellen Sie eine neue GitHub-App

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## GitHub-Anwendungskonfiguration [#github-application-configuration]

-  Geben Sie ihm einen `GitHub App name` und legen Sie Ihre `Homepage URL` fest
    - Beispiel für localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Beispiel für eine Domain: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- Fügen Sie eine gültige `Callback URL` hinzu:
    - Beispiel für localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Beispiel für eine Domain: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- Deaktivieren Sie das Kontrollkästchen mit der Beschriftung `Active` im Abschnitt `Webhook`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- Scrollen Sie nach unten zu `Account permissions` und setzen Sie `Email addresses` auf `Access: Read-only`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- Klicken Sie auf `Create GitHub App`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## .env Konfiguration [#env-configuration]

- Klicken Sie auf `Generate a new client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- Kopiere die `Client ID` und das `Client Secret` in die `.env` Datei

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- Speichern Sie die `.env` Datei

> **Hinweis:** Wenn Sie Docker verwenden, führen Sie `docker compose up -d` aus, um die Konfigurationsänderungen in der .env anzuwenden.

---

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/github.es.mdx

title: GitHub
icon: Github
description: >-
  Aprende a configurar LibreChat para usar GitHub para la autenticación de
  usuarios.

## Crear una aplicación de GitHub [#create-a-github-application]

- Ve a tu **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)**
- Crear una nueva GitHub app

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## Configuración de la aplicación de GitHub [#github-application-configuration]

-  Asígnale un `GitHub App name` y configura tu `Homepage URL`
    - Ejemplo para localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Ejemplo para un dominio: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- Agregue una `Callback URL` válida:
    - Ejemplo para localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Ejemplo para un dominio: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- Desmarque la casilla etiquetada como `Active` en la sección `Webhook`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- Desplácese hacia abajo hasta `Account permissions` y configure `Email addresses` en `Access: Read-only`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- Haz clic en `Create GitHub App`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## Configuración de .env [#env-configuration]

- Haz clic en `Generate a new client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- Copia el `Client ID` y el `Client Secret` en el archivo `.env`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- Guarda el archivo `.env`

> **Nota:** Si utiliza Docker, ejecute `docker compose up -d` para aplicar los cambios de configuración en el archivo .env

---

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/github.fr.mdx

title: GitHub
icon: Github
description: >-
  Apprenez à configurer LibreChat pour utiliser GitHub pour l'authentification
  des utilisateurs.

## Créer une application GitHub [#create-a-github-application]

- Allez dans vos **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)**
- Créer une nouvelle application GitHub

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## Configuration de l'application GitHub [#github-application-configuration]

-  Donnez-lui un `GitHub App name` et définissez votre `Homepage URL`
    - Exemple pour localhost : `http://localhost:3080`
    - Exemple pour un domaine : `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- Ajoutez une `Callback URL` valide :
    - Exemple pour localhost : `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Exemple pour un domaine : `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- Décochez la case intitulée `Active` dans la section `Webhook`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- Faites défiler vers le bas jusqu'à `Account permissions` et réglez `Email addresses` sur `Access: Read-only`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- Cliquez sur `Create GitHub App`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## Configuration de .env [#env-configuration]

- Cliquez sur `Generate a new client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- Copiez le `Client ID` et le `Client Secret` dans le fichier `.env`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- Enregistrez le fichier `.env`

> **Remarque :** Si vous utilisez Docker, exécutez `docker compose up -d` pour appliquer les modifications de configuration du fichier .env

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/github.id.mdx

title: GitHub
icon: Github
description: >-
  Pelajari cara mengonfigurasi LibreChat untuk menggunakan GitHub sebagai
  autentikasi pengguna.

## Membuat Aplikasi GitHub [#create-a-github-application]

- Buka **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)** Anda
- Buat aplikasi GitHub baru

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## Konfigurasi Aplikasi GitHub [#github-application-configuration]

-  Berikan `GitHub App name` dan atur `Homepage URL` Anda
    - Contoh untuk localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Contoh untuk sebuah domain: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- Tambahkan `Callback URL` yang valid:
    - Contoh untuk localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Contoh untuk domain: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- Hapus centang pada kotak yang berlabel `Active` di bagian `Webhook`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- Gulir ke bawah ke `Account permissions` dan atur `Email addresses` ke `Access: Read-only`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- Klik `Create GitHub App`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## Konfigurasi .env [#env-configuration]

- Klik `Generate a new client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- Salin `Client ID` dan `Client Secret` di dalam file `.env`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- Simpan file `.env`

> **Catatan:** Jika menggunakan Docker, jalankan `docker compose up -d` untuk menerapkan perubahan konfigurasi .env

title: GitHub
icon: Github
description: >-
  Scopri come configurare LibreChat per utilizzare GitHub per l'autenticazione
  degli utenti.

## Crea un'applicazione GitHub [#create-a-github-application]

- Vai alle tue **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)**
- Crea una nuova GitHub app

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## Configurazione dell'applicazione GitHub [#github-application-configuration]

-  Assegna un `GitHub App name` e imposta il tuo `Homepage URL`
    - Esempio per localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Esempio per un dominio: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- Aggiungi una `Callback URL` valida:
    - Esempio per localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Esempio per un dominio: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- Deseleziona la casella etichettata `Active` nella sezione `Webhook`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- Scorri verso il basso fino a `Account permissions` e imposta `Email addresses` su `Access: Read-only`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- Fai clic su `Create GitHub App`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## Configurazione di .env [#env-configuration]

- Fai clic su `Generate a new client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- Copia il `Client ID` e il `Client Secret` nel file `.env`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- Salva il file `.env`

> **Nota:** Se utilizzi Docker, esegui `docker compose up -d` per applicare le modifiche alla configurazione nel file .env

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/github.ja.mdx

title: GitHub
icon: Github
description: LibreChatでGitHubを使用したユーザー認証を設定する方法を学びます。

## GitHub アプリケーションを作成する [#create-a-github-application]

- **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)** に移動します。
- 新しいGitHubアプリを作成する

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## GitHub アプリケーションの設定 [#github-application-configuration]

-  `GitHub App name` を入力し、`Homepage URL` を設定してください。
    - localhostの例: `http://localhost:3080`
    - ドメインの例: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- 有効な `Callback URL` を追加します：
    - localhostの例: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - ドメインの例: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- `Webhook` セクションにある `Active` というラベルのチェックボックスのチェックを外します。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- `Account permissions` までスクロールし、`Email addresses` を `Access: Read-only` に設定します。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- `Create GitHub App` をクリックします

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## .env Configuration [#env-configuration]

- `Generate a new client secret` をクリックします

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- `.env` ファイル内の `Client ID` と `Client Secret` をコピーします。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- `.env` ファイルを保存します

> **注:** Docker を使用している場合は、`docker compose up -d` を実行して .env の設定変更を適用してください。

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/github.ko.mdx

title: GitHub
icon: Github
description: LibreChat에서 사용자 인증을 위해 GitHub를 구성하는 방법을 알아보세요.

## GitHub 애플리케이션 생성 [#create-a-github-application]

- **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)**로 이동하세요.
- 새로운 GitHub 앱 만들기

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## GitHub 애플리케이션 구성 [#github-application-configuration]

-  `GitHub App name`을 지정하고 `Homepage URL`을 설정하세요.
    - localhost 예시: `http://localhost:3080`
    - 도메인 예시: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- 유효한 `Callback URL`을 추가하세요:
    - localhost 예시: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - 도메인 예시: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- `Webhook` 섹션에서 `Active`라고 표시된 확인란의 선택을 해제하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- `Account permissions` 섹션으로 스크롤하여 `Email addresses`를 `Access: Read-only`로 설정하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- `Create GitHub App`을 클릭하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## .env 구성 [#env-configuration]

- `Generate a new client secret`를 클릭하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- `.env` 파일에 `Client ID`와 `Client Secret`을 복사하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- `.env` 파일을 저장하세요

> **참고:** Docker를 사용하는 경우, `docker compose up -d`를 실행하여 .env 구성 변경 사항을 적용하세요.

title: GitHub

description: Learn how to configure LibreChat to use GitHub for user authentication.

## Create a GitHub Application

- Go to your **[Github Developer settings](https://github.com/settings/apps)**
- Create a new GitHub app

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3a8b88e7-78f8-426e-bfc2-c5e3f8b21ccb)

## GitHub Application Configuration

-  Give it a `GitHub App name` and set your `Homepage URL`
    - Example for localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Example for a domain: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- Add a valid `Callback URL`:
    - Example for localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Example for a domain: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

- Uncheck the box labeled `Active` in the `Webhook` section

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- Scroll down to `Account permissions` and set `Email addresses` to `Access: Read-only`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- Click on `Create GitHub App`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## .env Configuration

- Click `Generate a new client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- Copy the `Client ID` and `Client Secret` in the `.env` file

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaf78840-48a9-44e1-9625-4109ed91d965)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/github/callback

# GitHub Enterprise (optional)
# Uncomment and configure the following if you are using GitHub Enterprise for authentication
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

- Save the `.env` file

> **Note:** If using Docker, run `docker compose up -d` to apply the .env configuration changes

-  Geef het een `GitHub App name` en stel je `Homepage URL` in
    - Voorbeeld voor localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Voorbeeld voor een domein: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f10d497d-460b-410f-9504-08735662648b)

- Voeg een geldige `Callback URL` toe:
    - Voorbeeld voor localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Voorbeeld voor een domein: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e7e6dba-0afb-4ed8-94bf-4c61b0f29240)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/aaeb3ecb-2e76-4ea5-8264-edfbdd53de1a)

- Scroll naar beneden naar `Account permissions` en stel `Email addresses` in op `Access: Read-only`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/3e561aa4-1f9e-4cb7-ace8-dbba8f0c0d55)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/7b5f99af-7bde-43ee-9b43-6d3ce79ee00a)

- Klik op `Create GitHub App`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

## .env Configuratie [#env-configuration]

- Klik op `Generate a new client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/484c7851-71dd-4167-a59e-9a56c4e08c36)

- Kopieer de `Client ID` en `Client Secret` in het `.env` bestand

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_BASE_URL=https://your-ghe-instance.com
# GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_USER_AGENT=YourEnterpriseAppName
```

> **Let op:** Als je Docker gebruikt, voer dan `docker compose up -d` uit om de wijzigingen in de .env configuratie toe te passen.

    - Exemplo para localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Exemplo para um domínio: `https://example.com`

    - Exemplo para localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/github/callback`
    - Exemplo para um domínio: `https://example.com/oauth/github/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4cc48550-eac3-4970-939b-81a23fa9c7cf)

- Clique em `Generate a new client secret`

## Google Anwendungskonfiguration [#google-application-configuration]

- Wählen Sie das soeben erstellte Projekt aus und gehen Sie zu `APIs and Services`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/c6265582-2cf6-430f-ae51-1edbdd9f2c48)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/232d46c0-dd00-4637-b538-3ba3bdbdc0b2)

- Geben Sie Ihre App-Informationen ein

> Hinweis: Sie können ein Logo aus Ihrem LibreChat-Ordner hier abrufen: `docs\assets\favicon_package\android-chrome-192x192.png`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e6c4c8ec-2f02-4af5-9458-c72394d0b7c5)

- Konfigurieren Sie Ihre `App domain` und fügen Sie Ihre `Developer contact information` hinzu, klicken Sie dann auf `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/6c2aa557-9b9b-412d-bc2b-76a0dc11f394)

- Configure the `Sopes`
    - Fügen Sie `email`, `profile` und `openid` hinzu
    - Klicken Sie auf `UPDATE` und `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/46af2fb9-8cfd-41c5-a763-814b308e45c3)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e832970-d392-4c67-bb38-908a5c51660a)

- Klicken Sie auf `SAVE AND CONTINUE`
- Überprüfen Sie Ihre App und kehren Sie zum Dashboard zurück

- Gehen Sie zurück zum Tab `Credentials`, klicken Sie auf `+ CREATE CREDENTIALS` und wählen Sie `OAuth client ID` aus.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/beef1982-55a3-4837-8e8c-20bad8d846ba)

- Wählen Sie `Web application` aus und geben Sie ihr einen Namen

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/badde864-f6b5-468f-a72f-bac93326ffa5)

- Konfigurieren Sie die `Authorized JavaScript origins`; Sie können sowohl Ihre Domain als auch localhost hinzufügen, falls gewünscht.
    - Beispiel für localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Beispiel für eine Domain: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- Fügen Sie eine gültige `Authorized redirect URIs` hinzu
    - Beispiel für localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - Beispiel für eine Domain: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## .env Konfiguration [#env-configuration]

- Klicken Sie auf `CREATE` und kopieren Sie Ihre `Client ID` und Ihr `Client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- Fügen Sie diese Ihrer `.env` Datei hinzu:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- Speichern Sie die `.env` Datei

> Hinweis: Wenn Sie Docker verwenden, führen Sie `docker compose up -d` aus, um die Konfigurationsänderungen in der .env anzuwenden.

---

- 新しいプロジェクトを作成し、名前を付けます

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/ce71c9ca-7ddd-4021-9133-a872c64c20c4)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/8abbd41e-8332-4851-898d-9cddb373c527)

## Google アプリケーションの設定 [#google-application-configuration]

- 作成したプロジェクトを選択し、`APIs and Services` に移動します。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/c6265582-2cf6-430f-ae51-1edbdd9f2c48)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/006e16ba-56b8-452d-b324-5f2d202637ab)

- `Credentials` を選択し、`CONFIGURE CONSENT SCREEN` をクリックします。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e4285cbb-833f-4366-820d-addf04a2ad77)

- `External` を選択し、`CREATE` をクリックします

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/232d46c0-dd00-4637-b538-3ba3bdbdc0b2)

- アプリ情報を入力してください

> 注: LibreChatフォルダ内のこちらからロゴを取得できます: `docs\assets\favicon_package\android-chrome-192x192.png`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e6c4c8ec-2f02-4af5-9458-c72394d0b7c5)

- `App domain` を設定し、`Developer contact information` を追加してから、`SAVE AND CONTINUE` をクリックしてください。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/6c2aa557-9b9b-412d-bc2b-76a0dc11f394)

- Configure the `Sopes`
    - `email`、`profile`、および `openid` を追加します
    - `UPDATE` をクリックし、`SAVE AND CONTINUE` をクリックします。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/46af2fb9-8cfd-41c5-a763-814b308e45c3)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e832970-d392-4c67-bb38-908a5c51660a)

- `SAVE AND CONTINUE` をクリックします
- アプリを確認してダッシュボードに戻る

- `Credentials` タブに戻り、`+ CREATE CREDENTIALS` をクリックして `OAuth client ID` を選択します。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/beef1982-55a3-4837-8e8c-20bad8d846ba)

- `Web application` を選択し、名前を付けます

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/badde864-f6b5-468f-a72f-bac93326ffa5)

- `Authorized JavaScript origins` を設定します。必要に応じて、ドメインと localhost の両方を追加できます。
    - localhostの例: `http://localhost:3080`
    - ドメインの例: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- 有効な `Authorized redirect URIs` を追加してください
    - localhostの例: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - ドメインの例: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## .env Configuration [#env-configuration]

- `CREATE` をクリックし、`Client ID` と `Client secret` をコピーします。

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- `.env` ファイルに追加してください：

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- `.env` ファイルを保存します

> 注: Dockerを使用している場合は、`docker compose up -d` を実行して .env の設定変更を適用してください。

# google.ko.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/google.ko.mdx

title: Google
icon: Google
description: LibreChat에서 사용자 인증을 위해 Google을 사용하도록 구성하는 방법을 알아보세요.

## Google 애플리케이션 만들기 [#create-a-google-application]

- 다음 사이트를 방문하세요: **[Google Cloud Console](https://cloud.google.com)** 그리고 `Console`을 여세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/a7d290ea-6031-43b3-b367-36ce00e46f20)

- 새 프로젝트를 생성하고 이름을 지정하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/ce71c9ca-7ddd-4021-9133-a872c64c20c4)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/8abbd41e-8332-4851-898d-9cddb373c527)

## Google 애플리케이션 구성 [#google-application-configuration]

- 방금 생성한 프로젝트를 선택하고 `APIs and Services`로 이동하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/c6265582-2cf6-430f-ae51-1edbdd9f2c48)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/006e16ba-56b8-452d-b324-5f2d202637ab)

- `Credentials`를 선택하고 `CONFIGURE CONSENT SCREEN`을 클릭하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e4285cbb-833f-4366-820d-addf04a2ad77)

- `External`을 선택한 다음 `CREATE`를 클릭하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/232d46c0-dd00-4637-b538-3ba3bdbdc0b2)

- 앱 정보를 입력하세요

> 참고: LibreChat 폴더의 다음 경로에서 로고를 가져올 수 있습니다: `docs\assets\favicon_package\android-chrome-192x192.png`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e6c4c8ec-2f02-4af5-9458-c72394d0b7c5)

- `App domain`을 구성하고 `Developer contact information`을 추가한 다음 `SAVE AND CONTINUE`를 클릭하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/6c2aa557-9b9b-412d-bc2b-76a0dc11f394)

- Configure the `Sopes`
    - `email`, `profile`, `openid`를 추가하세요
    - `UPDATE` 및 `SAVE AND CONTINUE`를 클릭하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/46af2fb9-8cfd-41c5-a763-814b308e45c3)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e832970-d392-4c67-bb38-908a5c51660a)

- `SAVE AND CONTINUE`를 클릭하세요
- 앱을 검토하고 대시보드로 돌아가세요

- `Credentials` 탭으로 돌아가서 `+ CREATE CREDENTIALS`를 클릭하고 `OAuth client ID`를 선택하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/beef1982-55a3-4837-8e8c-20bad8d846ba)

- `Web application`을 선택하고 이름을 지정하세요

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/badde864-f6b5-468f-a72f-bac93326ffa5)

- `Authorized JavaScript origins`를 구성하세요. 원하신다면 도메인과 localhost를 모두 추가할 수 있습니다.
    - localhost 예시: `http://localhost:3080`
    - 도메인 예시: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- 유효한 `Authorized redirect URIs`를 추가하세요
    - localhost 예시: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - 도메인 예시: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## .env 구성 [#env-configuration]

- `CREATE`를 클릭하고 `Client ID`와 `Client secret`을 복사하세요.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- `.env` 파일에 추가하세요:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- `.env` 파일을 저장하세요

> 참고: Docker를 사용하는 경우, `docker compose up -d`를 실행하여 .env 구성 변경 사항을 적용하세요.

# google.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/google.mdx

title: Google
icon: Google
description: Learn how to configure LibreChat to use Google for user authentication.

## Create a Google Application

- Visit: **[Google Cloud Console](https://cloud.google.com)** and open the `Console`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/a7d290ea-6031-43b3-b367-36ce00e46f20)

- Create a New Project and give it a name

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/ce71c9ca-7ddd-4021-9133-a872c64c20c4)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/8abbd41e-8332-4851-898d-9cddb373c527)

## Google Application Configuration

- Select the project you just created and go to `APIs and Services`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/c6265582-2cf6-430f-ae51-1edbdd9f2c48)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/006e16ba-56b8-452d-b324-5f2d202637ab)

- Select `Credentials` and click `CONFIGURE CONSENT SCREEN`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e4285cbb-833f-4366-820d-addf04a2ad77)

- Select `External` then click `CREATE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/232d46c0-dd00-4637-b538-3ba3bdbdc0b2)

- Fill in your App information

> Note: You can get a logo from your LibreChat folder here: `docs\assets\favicon_package\android-chrome-192x192.png`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e6c4c8ec-2f02-4af5-9458-c72394d0b7c5)

- Configure your `App domain` and add your `Developer contact information` then click `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/6c2aa557-9b9b-412d-bc2b-76a0dc11f394)

- Configure the `Sopes`
    - Add `email`,`profile` and `openid`
    - Click `UPDATE` and `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/46af2fb9-8cfd-41c5-a763-814b308e45c3)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e832970-d392-4c67-bb38-908a5c51660a)

- Click `SAVE AND CONTINUE`
- Review your app and go back to dashboard

- Go back to the `Credentials` tab, click on `+ CREATE CREDENTIALS` and select `OAuth client ID`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/beef1982-55a3-4837-8e8c-20bad8d846ba)

- Select `Web application` and give it a name

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/badde864-f6b5-468f-a72f-bac93326ffa5)

- Configure the `Authorized JavaScript origins`, you can add both your domain and localhost if you desire
    - Example for localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Example for a domain: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- Add a valid `Authorized redirect URIs`
    - Example for localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - Example for a domain: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## .env Configuration

- Click `CREATE` and copy your `Client ID` and `Client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- Add them to your `.env` file:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- Save the `.env` file

> Note: If using docker, run `docker compose up -d` to apply the .env configuration changes

> Let op: Je kunt een logo uit je LibreChat-map hier vinden: `docs\assets\favicon_package\android-chrome-192x192.png`

    - Voeg `email`, `profile` en `openid` toe
    - Klik op `UPDATE` en `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

- Configureer de `Authorized JavaScript origins`, je kunt zowel je domein als localhost toevoegen als je dat wilt
    - Voorbeeld voor localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Voorbeeld voor een domein: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- Voeg een geldige `Authorized redirect URIs` toe
    - Voorbeeld voor localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - Voorbeeld voor een domein: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## .env Configuratie [#env-configuration]

- Klik op `CREATE` en kopieer je `Client ID` en `Client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- Voeg ze toe aan je `.env` bestand:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- Sla het `.env` bestand op

> Let op: Als je Docker gebruikt, voer dan `docker compose up -d` uit om de wijzigingen in de .env configuratie toe te passen.

## Konfiguracja aplikacji Google [#google-application-configuration]

- Wybierz projekt, który właśnie utworzyłeś i przejdź do `APIs and Services`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/c6265582-2cf6-430f-ae51-1edbdd9f2c48)

- Wybierz `External`, a następnie kliknij `CREATE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/232d46c0-dd00-4637-b538-3ba3bdbdc0b2)

- Wypełnij informacje o swojej aplikacji

> Uwaga: Logo możesz pobrać ze swojego folderu LibreChat tutaj: `docs\assets\favicon_package\android-chrome-192x192.png`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e6c4c8ec-2f02-4af5-9458-c72394d0b7c5)

- Skonfiguruj swoją `App domain` i dodaj `Developer contact information`, a następnie kliknij `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/6c2aa557-9b9b-412d-bc2b-76a0dc11f394)

    - Dodaj `email`, `profile` oraz `openid`
    - Kliknij `UPDATE` oraz `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

    - Przykład dla localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Przykład dla domeny: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- Dodaj poprawny `Authorized redirect URIs`
    - Przykład dla localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - Przykład dla domeny: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## Konfiguracja .env [#env-configuration]

- Kliknij `CREATE` i skopiuj swój `Client ID` oraz `Client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- Dodaj je do swojego pliku `.env`:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- Zapisz plik `.env`

> Uwaga: Jeśli używasz Docker, uruchom `docker compose up -d`, aby zastosować zmiany w konfiguracji .env

## Configuração do Aplicativo Google [#google-application-configuration]

- Selecione o projeto que você acabou de criar e vá para `APIs and Services`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/6c2aa557-9b9b-412d-bc2b-76a0dc11f394)

- Configure the `Sopes`
    - Adicione `email`, `profile` e `openid`
    - Clique em `UPDATE` e `SAVE AND CONTINUE`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/46af2fb9-8cfd-41c5-a763-814b308e45c3)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e832970-d392-4c67-bb38-908a5c51660a)

- Clique em `SAVE AND CONTINUE`
- Revise seu aplicativo e volte ao dashboard

- Volte para a aba `Credentials`, clique em `+ CREATE CREDENTIALS` e selecione `OAuth client ID`

- Configure as `Authorized JavaScript origins`, você pode adicionar tanto o seu domínio quanto localhost, se desejar.
    - Exemplo para localhost: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Exemplo para um domínio: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- Adicione um `Authorized redirect URIs` válido
    - Exemplo para localhost: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - Exemplo para um domínio: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## Configuração do .env [#env-configuration]

- Clique em `CREATE` e copie seu `Client ID` e `Client secret`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- Adicione-os ao seu `.env` file:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- Salve o arquivo `.env`

> Nota: Se estiver usando Docker, execute `docker compose up -d` para aplicar as alterações de configuração do .env

description: >-

- Yeni bir Proje oluşturun ve ona bir isim verin

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/ce71c9ca-7ddd-4021-9133-a872c64c20c4)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/8abbd41e-8332-4851-898d-9cddb373c527)

## Google Uygulama Yapılandırması [#google-application-configuration]

- Az önce oluşturduğunuz projeyi seçin ve `APIs and Services` kısmına gidin

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/c6265582-2cf6-430f-ae51-1edbdd9f2c48)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/006e16ba-56b8-452d-b324-5f2d202637ab)

- `Credentials` öğesini seçin ve `CONFIGURE CONSENT SCREEN` düğmesine tıklayın

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e4285cbb-833f-4366-820d-addf04a2ad77)

- `External` öğesini seçin ve ardından `CREATE` düğmesine tıklayın

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/232d46c0-dd00-4637-b538-3ba3bdbdc0b2)

- Uygulama bilgilerinizi doldurun

> Not: LibreChat klasörünüzden bir logoyu buradan alabilirsiniz: `docs\assets\favicon_package\android-chrome-192x192.png`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/e6c4c8ec-2f02-4af5-9458-c72394d0b7c5)

- `App domain` bilginizi yapılandırın ve `Developer contact information` bilginizi ekleyin, ardından `SAVE AND CONTINUE` düğmesine tıklayın.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/6c2aa557-9b9b-412d-bc2b-76a0dc11f394)

- Configure the `Sopes`
    - `email`, `profile` ve `openid` ekleyin
    - `UPDATE` ve `SAVE AND CONTINUE` düğmelerine tıklayın

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/46af2fb9-8cfd-41c5-a763-814b308e45c3)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/4e832970-d392-4c67-bb38-908a5c51660a)

- `SAVE AND CONTINUE` düğmesine tıklayın
- Uygulamanızı gözden geçirin ve kontrol paneline geri dönün

- `Credentials` sekmesine geri dönün, `+ CREATE CREDENTIALS` öğesine tıklayın ve `OAuth client ID` seçeneğini belirleyin.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/beef1982-55a3-4837-8e8c-20bad8d846ba)

- `Web application` seçeneğini belirleyin ve bir ad verin

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/badde864-f6b5-468f-a72f-bac93326ffa5)

- `Authorized JavaScript origins` kısmını yapılandırın; dilerseniz hem alan adınızı hem de localhost'u ekleyebilirsiniz.
    - localhost için örnek: `http://localhost:3080`
    - Bir alan adı için örnek: `https://example.com`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/f7e3763a-5f74-4850-8638-44f81693b9ac)

- Geçerli bir `Authorized redirect URIs` ekleyin
    - localhost için örnek: `http://localhost:3080/oauth/google/callback`
    - Bir alan adı için örnek: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

## .env Yapılandırması [#env-configuration]

- `CREATE` düğmesine tıklayın ve `Client ID` ile `Client secret` bilgilerinizi kopyalayın

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/fa8572bf-f482-457a-a285-aec7d41af76b)

- Bunları `.env` dosyanıza ekleyin:

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- `.env` dosyasını kaydedin

> Not: Docker kullanıyorsanız, .env yapılandırma değişikliklerini uygulamak için `docker compose up -d` komutunu çalıştırın.

    - Ví dụ cho một tên miền: `https://example.com/oauth/google/callback`

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/138638445/0db34b19-d780-4651-9c2f-d33e24a74d55)

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

- Lưu tệp `.env`

> Lưu ý: Nếu sử dụng Docker, hãy chạy `docker compose up -d` để áp dụng các thay đổi cấu hình trong .env

    - 域名示例：`https://example.com`

```bash filename=".env"
DOMAIN_CLIENT=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain
DOMAIN_SERVER=https://your-domain.com # use http://localhost:3080 if not using a custom domain

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your_client_secret
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/google/callback
```

> 注意：如果使用 Docker，请运行 `docker compose up -d` 以应用 .env 配置更改。

- [Keycloak](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/keycloak)
- [OpenID-Token für Anmeldesitzungen wiederverwenden](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/token-reuse)

## Fehlerbehebung bei OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Falls Probleme mit der OpenID Connect-Authentifizierung auftreten:

1. **Header-Debug-Logging aktivieren**: Setzen Sie `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` in Ihren Umgebungsvariablen, um zusätzlich zu den URLs auch Anfrage-Header zu protokollieren (wobei sensible Daten maskiert werden). Hinweis: Anfrage-URLs werden immer auf der Debug-Ebene protokolliert.
2. **Redirect-URIs überprüfen**: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre Callback-URL exakt zwischen Ihrem Anbieter und der LibreChat-Konfiguration übereinstimmt.
3. **Scopes überprüfen**: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle erforderlichen Scopes ordnungsgemäß konfiguriert sind
4. **Anbieter-Logs überprüfen**: Überprüfen Sie die Logs Ihres Identitätsanbieters auf Authentifizierungsfehler
5. **Token validieren**: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihr Provider gültige Token mit den erwarteten Claims ausstellt
6. **Stellen Sie sicher, dass _nonce_ generiert wird**: Einige Identitätsanbieter generieren den `nonce` URL-Parameter, falls er in der Anfrage fehlt. Setzen Sie `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true`, um den openid-client dazu zu zwingen, diesen zu generieren.

### Admin-Panel-Weiterleitungen [#admin-panel-redirects]

Wenn das Admin Panel unter einer separaten URL von LibreChat gehostet wird, setzen Sie [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) in der LibreChat API-Umgebung. Dies teilt LibreChat mit, wohin Administratoren nach Abschluss des Admin-OAuth- oder SSO-Callbacks weitergeleitet werden sollen.

## Solución de problemas de OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Si encuentras problemas con la autenticación de OpenID Connect:

1. **Habilitar el registro de depuración de encabezados**: Establezca `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` en sus variables de entorno para registrar los encabezados de las solicitudes además de las URLs (con los datos confidenciales enmascarados). Tenga en cuenta que las URLs de las solicitudes siempre se registran en el nivel de depuración.
2. **Verificar URIs de redirección**: Asegúrese de que su URL de callback coincida exactamente entre su proveedor y la configuración de LibreChat
3. **Verificar Scopes**: Asegúrese de que todos los scopes requeridos estén configurados correctamente
4. **Revisar los registros del proveedor**: Compruebe los registros de su proveedor de identidad para detectar errores de autenticación
5. **Validar tokens**: Asegúrese de que su proveedor esté emitiendo tokens válidos con las declaraciones esperadas
6. **Asegúrese de que se genere el _nonce_**: Algunos proveedores de identidad generan el parámetro de URL `nonce` si falta en la solicitud. Establezca `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` para forzar a openid-client a generarlo.

Si el Admin Panel está alojado en una URL separada de LibreChat, configure [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) en el entorno de la API de LibreChat. Esto le indica a LibreChat a dónde enviar a los administradores una vez que se complete la devolución de llamada de OAuth o SSO del administrador.

Si vous rencontrez des problèmes avec l'authentification OpenID Connect :

## Pemecahan Masalah OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Jika Anda mengalami masalah dengan autentikasi OpenID Connect:

1. **Aktifkan Logging Debug Header**: Atur `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` di variabel lingkungan Anda untuk mencatat header permintaan selain URL (dengan data sensitif disamarkan). Catatan: URL permintaan selalu dicatat pada level debug.
2. **Periksa URI Pengalihan**: Pastikan URL callback Anda sama persis antara penyedia Anda dan konfigurasi LibreChat
3. **Verifikasi Scope**: Pastikan semua scope yang diperlukan telah dikonfigurasi dengan benar
4. **Tinjau Log Penyedia**: Periksa log penyedia identitas Anda untuk melihat kesalahan autentikasi
5. **Validasi Token**: Pastikan penyedia Anda menerbitkan token yang valid dengan klaim yang diharapkan
6. **Pastikan _nonce_ dibuat**: Beberapa penyedia identitas membuat parameter url `nonce` jika parameter tersebut tidak ada dalam permintaan. Atur `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` untuk memaksa openid-client membuatnya.

### Pengalihan Panel Admin [#admin-panel-redirects]

Jika Admin Panel dihosting pada URL yang terpisah dari LibreChat, atur [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) di lingkungan API LibreChat. Ini memberi tahu LibreChat ke mana harus mengarahkan admin setelah callback OAuth atau SSO admin selesai.

## Risoluzione dei problemi di OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Se riscontri problemi con l'autenticazione OpenID Connect:

1. **Abilita il debug logging delle intestazioni**: Imposta `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` nelle tue variabili d'ambiente per registrare le intestazioni delle richieste oltre agli URL (con i dati sensibili mascherati). Nota: gli URL delle richieste vengono sempre registrati al livello di debug.
2. **Controlla gli URI di reindirizzamento**: Assicurati che il tuo URL di callback corrisponda esattamente tra il tuo provider e la configurazione di LibreChat
3. **Verifica degli ambiti (Scopes)**: Assicurati che tutti gli ambiti richiesti siano configurati correttamente
4. **Esamina i log del provider**: Controlla i log del tuo identity provider per errori di autenticazione
5. **Convalida i token**: Assicurati che il tuo provider stia emettendo token validi con le attestazioni (claims) previste
6. **Assicurati che il _nonce_ sia generato**: Alcuni provider di identità generano il parametro url `nonce` se manca nella richiesta. Imposta `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` per forzare l'openid-client a generarlo.

## OpenID Connect のトラブルシューティング [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

OpenID Connect認証で問題が発生した場合：

1. **ヘッダーデバッグログの有効化**: 環境変数に `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` を設定すると、URLに加えてリクエストヘッダーもログに記録されます（機密データはマスクされます）。なお、リクエストURLは常にデバッグレベルでログに記録されることに注意してください。
2. **リダイレクトURIの確認**: プロバイダー側とLibreChatの設定側で、コールバックURLが完全に一致していることを確認してください。
3. **スコープの検証**: 必要なすべてのスコープが適切に設定されていることを確認してください
4. **プロバイダーログの確認**: 認証エラーがないか、IDプロバイダーのログを確認してください
5. **トークンの検証**: プロバイダーが期待されるクレームを含む有効なトークンを発行していることを確認してください。
6. **_nonce_ が生成されることを確認する**: 一部のアイデンティティプロバイダーは、リクエスト内に `nonce` URL パラメーターがない場合に生成を行います。`OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` を設定して、openid-client に強制的に生成させるようにしてください。

### 管理パネルのリダイレクト [#admin-panel-redirects]

Admin PanelがLibreChatとは別のURLでホストされている場合は、LibreChat API環境で [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) を設定してください。これは、管理者用OAuthまたはSSOのコールバック完了後に、管理者をどこへリダイレクトするかをLibreChatに指示するものです。

## OAuth2

## OpenID Connect 문제 해결 [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

OpenID Connect 인증과 관련하여 문제가 발생하는 경우:

1. **헤더 디버그 로깅 활성화**: 환경 변수에 `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true`를 설정하면 URL 외에도 요청 헤더를 로그에 기록할 수 있습니다(민감한 데이터는 마스킹 처리됨). 참고: 요청 URL은 항상 디버그 레벨에서 기록됩니다.
2. **리디렉션 URI 확인**: 공급자와 LibreChat 구성 간의 콜백 URL이 정확히 일치하는지 확인하세요.
3. **Verify Scopes**: 필수 범위(scope)가 올바르게 구성되었는지 확인하세요.
4. **제공자 로그 검토**: 인증 오류가 있는지 ID 제공자의 로그를 확인하세요.
5. **토큰 검증(Validate Tokens)**: 제공자가 예상된 클레임(claims)을 포함한 유효한 토큰을 발급하고 있는지 확인하세요.
6. **_nonce_가 생성되도록 보장**: 일부 ID 공급자는 요청에 `nonce` URL 매개변수가 누락된 경우 이를 생성합니다. `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true`를 설정하여 openid-client가 강제로 이를 생성하도록 하십시오.

### 관리자 패널 리다이렉트 [#admin-panel-redirects]

Admin Panel이 LibreChat과 별도의 URL에서 호스팅되는 경우, LibreChat API 환경에서 [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url)을 설정하세요. 이는 관리자 OAuth 또는 SSO 콜백이 완료된 후 관리자를 어디로 리디렉션할지 LibreChat에 알려줍니다.

## Troubleshooting OpenID Connect

If you encounter issues with OpenID Connect authentication:

1. **Enable Header Debug Logging**: Set `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` in your environment variables to log request headers in addition to URLs (with sensitive data masked). Note: Request URLs are always logged at debug level
2. **Check Redirect URIs**: Ensure your callback URL matches exactly between your provider and LibreChat configuration
3. **Verify Scopes**: Make sure all required scopes are properly configured
4. **Review Provider Logs**: Check your identity provider's logs for authentication errors
5. **Validate Tokens**: Ensure your provider is issuing valid tokens with the expected claims
6. **Ensure _nonce_ is generated**: Some identity providers generate `nonce` url parameter if it's missing in the request. Set `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` to force the openid-client to generate it.

### Admin Panel Redirects

If the Admin Panel is hosted on a separate URL from LibreChat, set [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) in the LibreChat API environment. This tells LibreChat where to send admins after the admin OAuth or SSO callback completes.

## Problemen oplossen met OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Als u problemen ondervindt met OpenID Connect-authenticatie:

1. **Header-debuglogboekregistratie inschakelen**: Stel `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` in uw omgevingsvariabelen in om naast URL's ook aanvraagheaders te loggen (waarbij gevoelige gegevens worden gemaskeerd). Let op: Aanvraag-URL's worden altijd op debug-niveau gelogd.
2. **Controleer Redirect URIs**: Zorg ervoor dat je callback-URL exact overeenkomt tussen je provider en de LibreChat configuratie
3. **Scopes verifiëren**: Zorg ervoor dat alle vereiste scopes correct zijn geconfigureerd
4. **Review Provider Logs**: Controleer de logs van uw identiteitsprovider op authenticatiefouten
5. **Tokens valideren**: Zorg ervoor dat uw provider geldige tokens uitgeeft met de verwachte claims
6. **Zorg ervoor dat _nonce_ wordt gegenereerd**: Sommige identiteitsaanbieders genereren een `nonce` url-parameter als deze ontbreekt in het verzoek. Stel `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` in om de openid-client te dwingen deze te genereren.

### Omleidingen in het Admin Panel [#admin-panel-redirects]

Als het Admin Panel op een aparte URL wordt gehost dan LibreChat, stel dan [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) in de LibreChat API-omgeving in. Dit vertelt LibreChat waar beheerders naartoe moeten worden gestuurd nadat de admin OAuth- of SSO-callback is voltooid.

## Rozwiązywanie problemów z OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Jeśli napotkasz problemy z uwierzytelnianiem OpenID Connect:

1. **Włącz debugowanie nagłówków**: Ustaw `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` w swoich zmiennych środowiskowych, aby logować nagłówki żądań oprócz adresów URL (z zamaskowanymi danymi wrażliwymi). Pamiętaj, że adresy URL żądań są zawsze logowane na poziomie debugowania.
2. **Sprawdź identyfikatory URI przekierowania**: Upewnij się, że Twój adres URL wywołania zwrotnego (callback URL) jest dokładnie taki sam w konfiguracji dostawcy oraz w LibreChat
3. **Weryfikacja zakresów (Scopes)**: Upewnij się, że wszystkie wymagane zakresy są poprawnie skonfigurowane
4. **Przejrzyj logi dostawcy**: Sprawdź logi swojego dostawcy tożsamości pod kątem błędów uwierzytelniania
5. **Weryfikacja tokenów**: Upewnij się, że Twój dostawca wydaje poprawne tokeny z oczekiwanymi oświadczeniami (claims)
6. **Upewnij się, że _nonce_ jest generowane**: Niektórzy dostawcy tożsamości generują parametr adresu URL `nonce`, jeśli brakuje go w żądaniu. Ustaw `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true`, aby wymusić na openid-client jego wygenerowanie.

### Przekierowania panelu administratora [#admin-panel-redirects]

Jeśli Panel Administratora jest hostowany pod innym adresem URL niż LibreChat, ustaw [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) w środowisku API LibreChat. Informuje to LibreChat, dokąd przekierować administratorów po zakończeniu wywołania zwrotnego OAuth lub SSO administratora.

## Solução de problemas do OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Se você encontrar problemas com a autenticação OpenID Connect:

1. **Habilitar Log de Depuração de Cabeçalho**: Defina `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` em suas variáveis de ambiente para registrar os cabeçalhos das requisições além das URLs (com dados sensíveis mascarados). Observe que as URLs das requisições são sempre registradas no nível de depuração.
2. **Verificar URIs de Redirecionamento**: Certifique-se de que sua URL de retorno corresponda exatamente entre seu provedor e a configuração do LibreChat
3. **Verificar Escopos**: Certifique-se de que todos os escopos necessários estejam configurados corretamente
4. **Revisar Logs do Provedor**: Verifique os logs do seu provedor de identidade para erros de autenticação
5. **Validar Tokens**: Certifique-se de que seu provedor esteja emitindo tokens válidos com as declarações (claims) esperadas
6. **Garanta que o _nonce_ seja gerado**: Alguns provedores de identidade geram o parâmetro de URL `nonce` caso ele esteja ausente na requisição. Defina `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` para forçar o openid-client a gerá-lo.

### Redirecionamentos do Painel de Administração [#admin-panel-redirects]

Se o Admin Panel estiver hospedado em uma URL separada do LibreChat, defina [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) no ambiente da API do LibreChat. Isso informa ao LibreChat para onde enviar os administradores após a conclusão do callback de OAuth ou SSO do administrador.

## OpenID Connect Sorun Giderme [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

OpenID Connect kimlik doğrulaması ile ilgili sorunlarla karşılaşırsanız:

1. **Header Hata Ayıklama Günlüğünü Etkinleştir**: İstek başlıklarını URL'lere ek olarak günlüğe kaydetmek için (hassas veriler maskelenmiş şekilde) ortam değişkenlerinizde `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` ayarını yapın. Not: İstek URL'leri her zaman hata ayıklama seviyesinde günlüğe kaydedilir.
2. **Yönlendirme URI'lerini Kontrol Edin**: Geri çağırma (callback) URL'nizin sağlayıcınız ile LibreChat yapılandırması arasında tam olarak eşleştiğinden emin olun
3. **Kapsamları Doğrulayın**: Gerekli tüm kapsamların düzgün bir şekilde yapılandırıldığından emin olun
4. **Sağlayıcı Günlüklerini İnceleyin**: Kimlik doğrulama hataları için kimlik sağlayıcınızın günlüklerini kontrol edin
5. **Validate Tokens**: Sağlayıcınızın beklenen taleplerle (claims) geçerli token'lar yayınladığından emin olun
6. **_nonce_ değerinin oluşturulduğundan emin olun**: Bazı kimlik sağlayıcılar, istekte eksik olması durumunda `nonce` url parametresini oluşturur. openid-client'ın bunu zorunlu olarak oluşturmasını sağlamak için `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` olarak ayarlayın.

### Yönetici Paneli Yönlendirmeleri [#admin-panel-redirects]

Eğer Admin Panel, LibreChat'ten ayrı bir URL'de barındırılıyorsa, LibreChat API ortamında [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) ayarını yapın. Bu, yönetici OAuth veya SSO geri çağırması tamamlandıktan sonra LibreChat'in yöneticileri nereye yönlendireceğini belirtir.

- [Discord](/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/discord)

## Khắc phục sự cố OpenID Connect [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

Nếu bạn gặp sự cố với xác thực OpenID Connect:

1. **Bật Ghi nhật ký Gỡ lỗi Tiêu đề (Header Debug Logging)**: Thiết lập `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true` trong các biến môi trường của bạn để ghi nhật ký các tiêu đề yêu cầu (request headers) bên cạnh các URL (với dữ liệu nhạy cảm được ẩn đi). Lưu ý: Các URL yêu cầu luôn được ghi nhật ký ở cấp độ gỡ lỗi (debug level).
2. **Kiểm tra Redirect URIs**: Đảm bảo URL callback của bạn khớp chính xác giữa nhà cung cấp và cấu hình LibreChat
3. **Xác minh Scopes**: Đảm bảo tất cả các scope bắt buộc đã được cấu hình đúng cách
4. **Xem lại nhật ký nhà cung cấp**: Kiểm tra nhật ký của nhà cung cấp danh tính của bạn để tìm lỗi xác thực
5. **Xác thực Token**: Đảm bảo nhà cung cấp của bạn đang cấp các token hợp lệ với các xác nhận (claims) như mong đợi
6. **Đảm bảo _nonce_ được tạo**: Một số nhà cung cấp danh tính sẽ tạo tham số url `nonce` nếu nó bị thiếu trong yêu cầu. Hãy đặt `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` để buộc openid-client tạo tham số này.

### Chuyển hướng Bảng quản trị [#admin-panel-redirects]

Nếu Admin Panel được lưu trữ trên một URL riêng biệt với LibreChat, hãy thiết lập [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url) trong môi trường API của LibreChat. Điều này cho LibreChat biết nơi sẽ chuyển hướng quản trị viên sau khi quá trình callback OAuth hoặc SSO của quản trị viên hoàn tất.

## 排查 OpenID Connect 问题 [#troubleshooting-openid-connect]

如果您在使用 OpenID Connect 身份验证时遇到问题：

1. **启用 Header 调试日志记录**：在环境变量中设置 `DEBUG_OPENID_REQUESTS=true`，以便在记录 URL 的同时记录请求头（敏感数据会被屏蔽）。请注意：请求 URL 始终会在调试级别进行记录。
2. **检查重定向 URI**：确保您的回调 URL 在您的提供商和 LibreChat 配置之间完全一致
3. **验证作用域 (Verify Scopes)**：确保所有必需的作用域均已正确配置
4. **查看提供商日志**：检查您的身份提供商日志以查找身份验证错误
5. **验证令牌 (Validate Tokens)**：确保您的提供商正在颁发带有预期声明的有效令牌
6. **确保生成 _nonce_**：某些身份提供商会在请求中缺少 `nonce` URL 参数时自动生成该参数。设置 `OPENID_GENERATE_NONCE=true` 以强制 openid-client 生成它。

### 管理面板重定向 [#admin-panel-redirects]

如果 Admin Panel 托管在与 LibreChat 不同的 URL 上，请在 LibreChat API 环境中设置 [`ADMIN_PANEL_URL`](/docs/features/admin_panel#librechat-redirect-url)。这会告知 LibreChat 在管理员 OAuth 或 SSO 回调完成后将管理员重定向至何处。

# keycloak.de.mdx

Source: https://github.com/librechat-ai/librechat.ai/blob/main/content/docs/configuration/authentication/OAuth2-OIDC/keycloak.de.mdx

title: Keycloak
icon: Keycloak
description: >-
  Erfahren Sie, wie Sie LibreChat für die Benutzerauthentifizierung mit Keycloak
  konfigurieren.

1. **Zugriff auf die Keycloak Admin Console:**
- Öffnen Sie die Keycloak Admin Console in Ihrem Webbrowser. Diese finden Sie normalerweise unter einer URL wie `http://localhost:8080/auth/admin/`.

2. **Erstellen Sie ein Realm (falls erforderlich):**
- Falls Sie noch keinen Realm für Ihre Anwendung haben, erstellen Sie einen. Klicken Sie auf 'Add Realm' und geben Sie ihm einen Namen.

3. **Client erstellen:**
- Klicken Sie in Ihrem Bereich auf 'Clients' und dann auf 'Create'.
- Geben Sie eine Client-ID ein und wählen Sie 'openid-connect' als Client-Protokoll aus.
- Setzen Sie 'Client Authentication' auf 'On'.
- Geben Sie unter 'Valid Redirect URIs' `http://localhost:3080/oauth/openid/callback` oder den für Ihre Anwendung zutreffenden URI ein.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/d956de3d-e1f7-4327-818a-f146eb86a949)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/fbefbc05-b4ec-4122-8229-54a0a5876d76)

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/f75c7b0f-030e-4182-bf87-ccf3aeae17d4)

4. **Client konfigurieren:**
- Nachdem Sie den Client erstellt haben, werden Sie zu dessen Einstellungsseite weitergeleitet.
- Notieren Sie sich die 'Client ID' und das 'Secret' aus dem Reiter 'Credentials' – Sie werden diese für Ihre Anwendung benötigen.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/b1c1f0b6-641b-4cf7-a7f1-a9a32026d51b)

5. **Rollen hinzufügen (Optional):**
Wenn Sie den Zugriff auf Benutzer mit bestimmten Rollen beschränken möchten, können Sie Rollen in Keycloak definieren und diese den Benutzern zuweisen.
- Gehen Sie zum Reiter 'Roles' in Ihrem Client oder Realm (je nachdem, wo Sie die Rollen definieren möchten).
- Erstellen Sie Rollen, die mit dem/den Wert(en) übereinstimmen, den/die Sie in `OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE` festgelegt haben.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/67ca635f-5082-4dcc-97ac-019029a81d7c)

6. **Benutzern Rollen zuweisen (Optional):**
- Gehen Sie zu 'Users', wählen Sie einen Benutzer aus und wechseln Sie zum Tab 'Role Mappings'.
- Weisen Sie dem Benutzer mindestens eine der in `OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE` angegebenen Rollen zu.

![image](https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat/assets/6623884/f2ea70ed-e16c-4ec8-b84f-79fbfca627be)

7. **Pfad der Rollenliste innerhalb des Tokens abrufen (Optional):**
- Dekodieren Sie Ihr jwtToken vom OpenID-Anbieter und bestimmen Sie den Pfad für die Rollenliste innerhalb des Zugriffstokens. Wenn Sie beispielsweise Keycloak verwenden, lautet der Pfad `realm_access.roles`.
- Tragen Sie diesen Pfad in die Variable `OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_PARAMETER_PATH` in der `.env` Datei ein.
- Über den Parameter `OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_TOKEN_KIND` können Sie festlegen, welche Token-Art Sie verwenden möchten.
Mögliche Werte sind `access` und `id`.

8. **Aktualisieren Sie die Konfiguration Ihres Projekts:**
- Öffnen Sie die `.env` Datei in Ihrem Projektordner und fügen Sie die folgenden Variablen hinzu:
  ```bash filename=".env"
  OPENID_ISSUER=http://localhost:8080/realms/[YourRealmName]
  OPENID_CLIENT_ID=[YourClientID]
  OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET=[YourClientSecret]
  OPENID_SESSION_SECRET=[JustGenerateARandomSessionSecret]
  OPENID_CALLBACK_URL=/oauth/openid/callback
  OPENID_SCOPE="openid profile email"
  OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE=[YourRequiredRole] # Single role or comma-separated roles (e.g., role1,role2,admin)
  OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_TOKEN_KIND=(access|id) # that means, `access` or `id`
  OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE_PARAMETER_PATH="realm_access.roles"

  # Optional: redirects the user to the end session endpoint after logging out
  OPENID_USE_END_SESSION_ENDPOINT=true

  # Maximum logout URL length before using logout_hint instead of id_token_hint (default: 2000)
  # OPENID_MAX_LOGOUT_URL_LENGTH=2000
  ```

title: Keycloak

description: >-

Si deseas restringir el acceso a usuarios con roles específicos, puedes definir roles en Keycloak y asignarlos a los usuarios.
- Ve a la pestaña 'Roles' en tu cliente o reino (dependiendo de dónde quieras definir los roles).
- Cree roles que coincidan con el/los valor(es) que tiene en `OPENID_REQUIRED_ROLE`.

- Ve a 'Users', selecciona un usuario y ve a la pestaña 'Role Mappings'.
